shops.title: Aaron's Archery Appendages.
shops.notes: Aaron's Archery Appendages is a shop where Aaron the Armour salesman sells low level ranged armour . Aaron also sells the Ranged Cape of Accomplishment . His shop is located in the Ranging Guild , so it can only be accessed by players with at least level 40 Ranged .

shops.title: Aemad's Adventuring Supplies.
shops.notes: Aemad's Adventuring Supplies is a general store in East Ardougne . The store is run by its owner, Aemad , and his assistant, Kortan . Although it does not sell the default items of a typical general store, it sells several items used in quests around RuneScape, notably rope .

shops.title: Agelus' Farm Shop
shops.notes: Agelus' Farm Shop is a Farming shop located at the Ortus Farm west of Civitas illa Fortis . It is run by Agelus and it sells Farming supplies.

shops.title: Agility Arena Store
shops.notes: The Agility Arena Store is the rewards shop for the Brimhaven Agility Arena minigame , run by Pirate Jackie the Fruit at the minigame's entrance. Players can exchange Agility arena tickets for 345 Agility experience each (379.5 experience each with Karamja gloves 2 or higher equipped), and Brimhaven

shops.title: Agmundi Quality Clothes
shops.notes: Agmundi Quality Clothes is a store specialising in clothes designed for dwarves, although the owner Agmundi will sell to the few Humans who pass through Keldagrim . The shop stocks a supply of clothes made by Agmundi's sister, Vermundi . She stocks higher quality clothes than Vermundi, but at a high

shops.title: Ak-Haranu's Exotic Shop.
shops.notes: Ak-Haranu's Exotic Shop is a shop located in Port Phasmatys and owned by Ak-Haranu . It sells bolt racks . Ak-Haranu will only be there after giving the Old Crone a milky cup of tea during the Ghosts Ahoy quest.

shops.title: Al Kharid General Store
shops.notes: The Al Kharid General Store is a general store located in the desert town of Al Kharid .

shops.title: Aldarin General Store
shops.notes: Aldarin General Store is a general store run by a shopkeeper in north-eastern Aldarin .

shops.title: Aleck's Hunter Emporium.
shops.notes: Aleck's Hunter Emporium is a hunter shop in Yanille run by Aleck , just east of the tavern. The shop sells Hunter items and is managed and owned by Aleck . It is located conveniently close to the Feldip hunting grounds. Viewing the shop is a requirement for the easy Ardougne Diary .

shops.title: Ali's Discount Wares.
shops.notes: Ali's Discount Wares is a shop owned by the swindler Ali Morrisane . It sells similar items as a general store , as well as desert survival gear. After completion of Rogue Trader , other items can be bought from the store.

shops.title: Alice's Farming shop.
shops.notes: Alice's Farming shop is a Farming shop at Alice 's farm west of Port Phasmatys selling various Farming items and will buy some farming produce.

shops.title: Allanna's Farming Shop
shops.notes: Allanna's Farming Shop is a farming shop run by Allanna , located in the Farming Guild . It sells an assortment of farming tools and supplies.

shops.title: Alliance Supplies
shops.notes: Alliance Supplies is a shop run by the quartermaster in The Fractured Archive .

shops.title: Alry the Angler's Angling Accessories
shops.notes: Alry the Angler's Angling Accessories is a shop run by Alry the Angler that uses Molch pearls obtained from aerial fishing . Players can buy equipable versions of fishing rods, as well as a cosmetic fish sack that can be combined with the fish barrel to make the fish sack barrel . The shop also offe

shops.title: Amelia's Seed Shop
shops.notes: Amelia's Seed Shop is a seed shop run by Amelia , located in the Farming Guild . It sells an assortment of allotment, flower, and hops seeds.

shops.title: Amlodd's Magical Supplies
shops.notes: Amlodd's Magical Supplies is a rune shop run by Efa on the north-west side of Prifddinas . It is one of few shops to stock cosmic runes , and the only shop to stock more than 30.

shops.title: Aneirin's Armour
shops.notes: Aneirin's Armour is an armour shop run by Aneirin on the south side of Prifddinas .

shops.title: Apothecary's Potions
shops.notes: Apothecary's Potions is a small shop ran by the Apothecary . He sells three different potions if players give him the requested payment and ingredients. Noted ingredients will not work. This shop is available to free-to-play players as well as members .

shops.title: Archery shops
shops.notes: Archery shops are a type of store found in Old School RuneScape . The stores are represented by an icon. Archery shops sell items related to the Ranged skill. There are several Ranged-related stores located throughout Gielinor .

shops.title: Arcuani's Archery Supplies
shops.notes: Arcuani's Archery Supplies is a shop in Tal Teklan selling ranged gear. It is run by Arcuani .

shops.title: Ardougne Baker's Stall.
shops.notes: The Ardougne Baker's Stall is a store located on the east side of the East Ardougne market that sells bread , cake , chocolate slices , and chocolate bars . It is run by a baker . It requires 5 Thieving to steal from.

shops.title: Ardougne Fur Stall.
shops.notes: The Ardougne Fur Stall is a Fur stall in the south-eastern part of the East Ardougne marketplace . It is run by the fur trader .

shops.title: Ardougne Gem Stall.
shops.notes: The Ardougne Gem Stall is a gem shop in East Ardougne market run by the gem merchant .

shops.title: Ardougne Silver Stall.
shops.notes: Ardougne Silver Stall is a silver stall located in the East Ardougne Marketplace . It is run by the silver merchant .

shops.title: Ardougne Spice Stall.
shops.notes: The Ardougne Spice Stall is a spice stall in East Ardougne that sells knives , spices , and garlic . It is run by the spice seller .

shops.title: Arhein's General Goods
shops.notes: Arhein's General Goods is a general store in Catherby . It is run by Arhein and is also known as the Catherby General Store.

shops.title: Armour Shop
shops.notes: The Armour Shop is a store found on the Fremennik island of Jatizso , in the south-west corner. It is run by Raum Urda-Stein , and occupies the same building as the Ore Store , which is likely the source of its materials. One of the town's major resources is mining and smithing , which allows this s

shops.title: Armour store.
shops.notes: Armour store is a shop found in the Keldagrim Blast Furnace factory and run by Jorzik . Here players can sell smithed armour to the store. The armour can be re-purchased for the market value, as the shop has no stock. Iron men cannot buy items from the shop as the items will show as overstocked in t

shops.title: Armoury
shops.notes: Armoury is a shop in the Combat Training Camp . This shop sells various weapons for Melee and Ranged combat. The owner is a shop keeper . Buying from this shop is not recommended because it charges prices 50% higher than other shops that sell the same items.

shops.title: Arnold's Eclectic Supplies.
shops.notes: Arnold's Eclectic Supplies is a general store run by Arnold Lydspor at the Piscatoris Fishing Colony .

shops.title: Artima's Crafting Supplies
shops.notes: Artima's Crafting Supplies is a crafting shop owned by Artima in Civitas illa Fortis , just south of the Fortis Cothon .

shops.title: Atlazora's Rest
shops.notes: Atlazora's Rest is a bar found in Outer Fortis . During Twilight's Promise , players must visit Atlazora's Rest to find two off-duty knights , Velam and Azali.

shops.title: Auburn Pub
shops.notes: Auburn Pub is a pub located in Auburnvale . Its bartender sells food and a wide range of alcohol.

shops.title: Auburnvale General Store
shops.notes: Auburnvale General Store is a general store run by a shopkeeper in Auburnvale .

shops.title: Aubury's Rune Shop.
shops.notes: Aubury's Rune Shop. is a shop located in south-eastern Varrock and owned by Aubury . It is a small building just south of the eastern Varrock bank . The shop's easy to access location makes it one of the most convenient ways for players to buy runes and to teleport to the rune essence mine after the

shops.title: Aurel's Supplies
shops.notes: Aurel's Supplies is a general store in Burgh de Rott , owned by Aurel . It requires completion of In Aid of the Myreque , as during the quest the shop is repaired and stocked. It is also the area where Gadderanks is confronted, and the Gadderhammer , while not found in the shop, can be bought for 3,

shops.title: Authentic Throwing Weapons.
shops.notes: Authentic Throwing Weapons is a shop where the Tribal Weapon Salesman sells javelins and thrownaxes up to runite . The shop is located in the Ranging Guild , so it can only be accessed by players with a Ranged level of 40 or higher.

shops.title: Ava's Odds and Ends
shops.notes: Ava's Odds and Ends is a store owned by Ava that can be accessed after completing Animal Magnetism . It is located in the western room of Draynor Manor , opened by searching the bookcase . She does not sell her devices in the shop; players wishing to buy them can choose the right-click Devices optio

shops.title: Axe shops
shops.notes: Axe shops are a type of store throughout Gielinor . The stores are represented by a icon. Axe shops sell axes and battleaxes .

shops.title: Baba Yaga's Magic Shop.
shops.notes: Baba Yaga's Magic Shop. is a shop on the Lunar Isle run by Baba Yaga , a member of the Moon Clan . Her shop—in a house that walks around on chicken legs —offers a complete selection of runes except combination runes , cosmic runes and wrath runes . Prior to completing the elite Fremennik Diary , a S

shops.title: Bandit Bargains
shops.notes: Bandit Bargains is a general store in the Bandit Camp , owned by the Bandit shopkeeper . Like most general stores in the Kharidian Desert , it sells desert survival equipment. However, unlike usual general stores, you may not sell any tradeable item to this store. The owner will not attack if a play

shops.title: Bandit Duty Free
shops.notes: Bandit Duty Free , owned by Noterazzo , is a general store located in the Wilderness Bandit Camp . It offers some of the best prices among general stores, initially buying items at their high alchemy value (60% of the base value ) while most others buy at low alchemy value (40%).

shops.title: Barbarian Assault Reward Shop
shops.notes: The Barbarian Assault Reward Shop is run by Commander Connad at the Barbarian Outpost . Player may use honour points for upgrades, armour and to gamble for items. The maximum amount of honour points per role is 5,000.

shops.title: Barkers' Haberdashery
shops.notes: Barkers' Haberdashery is run by Barker . The shop sells an assortment of robe sets, gloves, and boots in five different colours; grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple. He also sells five coloured capes: red , black , blue , yellow , and green .

shops.title: Battle Runes
shops.notes: Battle Runes is a magic store in low-level Wilderness , owned by the Mage of Zamorak . It can be accessed before completing the Enter the Abyss miniquest , but after completion the stock will increase and blood runes will be added. It is one of the two Wilderness shops that sells runes , the other b

shops.title: Beach Cocktails
shops.notes: Beach Cocktails and Party Cocktails were identical shops available during the 2013 Midsummer event and 2013 Thanksgiving event respectively, run by the Cocktail seller . During the Midsummer event, it had multiple locations, such as on Catherby beach, in Al Kharid south of the bank, and in Brimhaven

shops.title: Beach Kit
shops.notes: Beach Kit was a shop available during the 2013 Midsummer event . It was run by Romettini and had multiple locations during the event. He could be found on the Catherby beach, in Al Kharid south of the bank, and in Brimhaven . The shop mainly sold dwarven clothing normally found in Agmundi Quality Cl

shops.title: Bedabin Village Bartering
shops.notes: Bedabin Village Bartering is a shop in the Bedabin Camp , run by the Bedabin Nomads . The Bartering store sells some basic items like a general store , but will not buy any non-stocked items from players. Although there are several nomads in the camp that offers to trade, the stock is shared among t

shops.title: Betty's Magic Emporium
shops.notes: Betty's Magic Emporium is located in Port Sarim and owned by Betty . It is the only shop in free-to-play that sells an eye of newt , which is required for the Witch's Potion quest .

shops.title: Blades by Urbi.
shops.notes: Blades by Urbi is a shop run by Urbi that sells daggers and scimitars in Sophanem next to her dagger stall . It is only available to players who have completed the Contact! quest.

shops.title: Blair's Armour
shops.notes: Blair's Armour is a shop located in the north-east corner of Shayzien . The shop is run by Blair .

shops.title: Blue Moon Inn
shops.notes: The Blue Moon Inn is a tavern and inn in south-central Varrock , marked by a sign at the front and back of the building. The NPCs inside play a role in several quests . Jonny the Beard is involved in the Shield of Arrav quest, Dr Harlow features in the Vampyre Slayer quest, and there is also a treas

shops.title: Blurberry Bar
shops.location: Grand Tree ( 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] )
shops.notes: Blurberry Bar is located inside the Grand Tree in the Gnome Stronghold . To get there, the player must climb to the 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] and turn east. Players may talk to Blurberry to learn the art of gnome cuisine, which will then allow players to begin playing the minigame Gnome Re

shops.title: Bob's Brilliant Axes.
shops.notes: Bob's Brilliant Axes is located in southern Lumbridge . It is the only shop in the city apart from the general store and the Lumbridge Blacksmith . Bob is also one of five NPCs that can repair Barrows equipment .

shops.title: Bolkoy's Village Shop
shops.location: Tree Gnome Village , 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ]
shops.notes: Bolkoy's Village Shop is a general store on the 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] of the Tree Gnome Village , owned by Bolkoy . It can be accessed before completing the Tree Gnome Village quest.

shops.title: Bounty Hunter Shop (Deadman Mode)
shops.notes: The Bounty Hunter Shop is a store run by the Emblem Trader at the Grand Exchange , which is accessible on both permanent and seasonal Deadman Mode worlds.

shops.title: Bounty Hunter Shop (historical)
shops.notes: The Bounty Hunter Shop was a store run by the Emblem Trader , located north of the Edgeville bank . Here, players could purchase items with their accumulated points obtained from playing Bounty Hunter .

shops.title: Bounty Hunter Store
shops.notes: The Bounty Hunter Store is a store run by the Emblem Trader , located in Daimon's Crater . Here, players can purchase items with their accumulated points obtained from playing Bounty Hunter .

shops.title: Branwen's Farming Shop
shops.notes: Branwen's Farming Shop is a farming shop run by Branwen on the east side of Prifddinas .

shops.title: Brian's Archery Supplies.
shops.notes: Brian's Archery Supplies is a Ranged supplies shop owned by Brian and located in Rimmington .

shops.title: Brian's Battleaxe Bazaar.
shops.notes: Brian's Battleaxe Bazaar is an axe shop located in Port Sarim and owned by Brian . The shop stocks battleaxes from bronze to adamant .

shops.title: Briget's Weapons
shops.notes: Briget's Weapons is a sword shop in the south-east corner of Shayzien run by Briget .

shops.title: Brimhaven Agility Arena Ticket Exchange
shops.notes: The Brimhaven Agility Arena Ticket Exchange is the former rewards shop for the Brimhaven Agility Arena minigame , accessed by talking to Pirate Jackie the Fruit at the minigame's entrance. At the ticket exchange, players could exchange the discontinued Agility arena tickets earned in the minigame fo

shops.title: Bunbridge General Store
shops.notes: The Bunbridge General Store is the general store located north of the Bunbridge Castle in Bunbridge . When new bunnies arrive in BunScape, they arrive in Bunbridge and tend to have a look around, and thus the store is a popular place for new bunnies.

shops.title: Burthorpe Supplies
shops.notes: Burthorpe Supplies is a general store run by Wistan in Burthorpe . Aside from the shopkeeper, the ground floor has some boxes, a bookcase, and non-interactive shelves and crates. The upper floor has crates, tables, beds, a fireplace, and some bookcases that the player can search.

shops.title: Cam Torum Blacksmith
shops.notes: Cam Torum Blacksmith is located in Cam Torum and operated by the blacksmith . It stocks various weapons and square shields, ranging from bronze to adamant.

shops.title: Cam Torum General Store
shops.notes: Cam Torum General Store is a shop located in the south-west corner of the Cam Torum market.

shops.title: Candle Shop
shops.notes: The Candle Shop , as the name implies, only sells candles . It is owned by the Candle maker and located in Catherby , just a little west of the town's bank . Players who need a black candle for the Merlin's Crystal quest can get one by trading a bucket of wax to this shop.

shops.title: Candle shops
shops.notes: Candle shops are a type of store throughout Gielinor . The stores are represented by a icon. Candle shops sell candles as well as other light sources . There are three regular candle shops in Old School RuneScape and one that is dialogue-only.

shops.title: Carefree Crafting Stall
shops.notes: The Carefree Crafting Stall is a Crafting stall run by Nolar , found on the eastern ground floor of Keldagrim Palace . It can be found between Hirko 's crossbow stall and Green Gemstone Gems . The shop is run by Nolar , a dwarf craftsman and open supporter of The White Chisel, an industrial company

shops.title: Cassie's Shield Shop.
shops.notes: Cassie's Shield Shop is a specialty shop owned by Cassie that sells shields . It is located in Falador , just west of the park and south-east of the northern gate of the city.

shops.title: Castle Wars Ticket Exchange
shops.notes: The Castle Wars Ticket Exchange is the store where players can purchase items with their accumulated Castle wars tickets and plaudits . The store is owned by Lanthus and is located in the Castle Wars lobby. Most of the items sold there are either for use in the Castle Wars minigame or as a decorativ

shops.title: Chainbody shops
shops.notes: Chainbody shops are a type of store throughout Gielinor . The stores are represented by an icon. Chainbody shops sell chainbodies . There are two dedicated chainbody shops in Old School RuneScape .

shops.title: Chest (Theatre of Blood)
shops.notes: A chest containing supplies can be found in the Theatre of Blood . It is accessible twice per raid — once after killing the Pestilent Bloat , and once after killing Sotetseg . It supplies players with different supplies provided by entertained vampyres, purchasable with points earned in the Theatre.

shops.title: Clothes shops
shops.notes: Clothes shops are a type of store found throughout Gielinor . Clothes shops sell assortments of various clothing , and many also sell sewing-relating items such as needles , thread , silk , fur , and balls of wool .

shops.title: Cobado
shops.notes: Cobado is the shop owner of Cobado's Groceries in Civitas illa Fortis . As noted by his examine text, he is wearing an orange as a hat, and has slightly different dialogue for players also wearing an orange as a hat.

shops.title: Cobado's Groceries
shops.notes: Cobado's Groceries is a cooking shop run by Cobado in Civitas illa Fortis , Varlamore .

shops.title: Commander Connad
shops.notes: Commander Connad is a barbarian located on the main floor of the Barbarian Outpost . He runs the Barbarian Assault Reward Shop for the Barbarian Assault minigame : players who have earned honour points while playing the minigame can talk to him to access the Reward Shop . shops.title: Conara's Jewels
shops.notes: Conara's Jewels is a jewellery shop located in Cam Torum and operated by Conara . The store sells many kinds of unenchanted jewellery , though it does not deal in dragonstone , onyx , or zenyte jewellery.

shops.title: Construction supplies
shops.notes: Construction supplies is a Construction supplies store found at the sawmills at the Lumberyard , in the Woodcutting Guild , north-east Prifddinas , and in the centre of Auburnvale . It is run by the Sawmill operators at each location. The shop stocks several items that can be used for creating furni

shops.title: Contraband yak produce.
shops.notes: Contraband yak produce is a store selling illegal yak goods, in central Jatizso , north of the longhall, owned by Vanligga Gastfrihet .

shops.title: Cooking shops
shops.notes: Cooking shops are a type of store throughout Gielinor . The stores are represented by a icon. Cooking shops sell utensils and food items used for Cooking . There are 5 cooking shops in Old School RuneScape .

shops.title: Crafting shops
shops.notes: A Crafting shop is a type of store throughout Gielinor . The stores are represented by a Icon . Crafting shops sell items used in Crafting . There are 11 Crafting shops in Old School RuneScape .

shops.title: Crossbow Shop (Dwarven Mine)
shops.notes: Hura's Crossbow Shop is a Crossbow stall run by Hura in the Dwarven Mine . It sells crossbow components, and has the same stock and prices as the White Wolf Mountain Crossbow Shop .

shops.title: Crossbow Shop (Keldagrim)
shops.notes: The Crossbow Shop in Keldagrim Palace is a Crossbow stall owned by Hirko that sells crossbows and crossbow components like other crossbow shops . It is located in the eastern side of the palace. By talking directly to Hirko, one may also purchase a Bolt pouch .

shops.title: Crossbow Shop (White Wolf Mountain)
shops.notes: Holoy's Crossbow Shop is a shop run by Holoy underneath White Wolf Mountain . It sells crossbow components, and has the same stock and prices as the Dwarven Mine Crossbow Shop .

shops.title: Crossbow shops
shops.notes: Crossbow shops are a type of store throughout Gielinor . Crossbow shops sell crossbow stocks , crossbow limbs , and crossbows . There are 3 crossbow shops in Old School RuneScape , but only the Keldagrim shop keeps parts for an adamant crossbow in stock.

shops.title: Culinaromancer's Chest
shops.notes: The Culinaromancer's Chest is a special chest accessible to players during and after the Recipe for Disaster quest . It has a bank , a food store that sells items for the Cooking skill, and a combat item store, including the highly-sought-after Barrows gloves .

shops.title: Custom Fur Clothing
shops.notes: Custom Fur Clothing is a service offered by several non-player characters to make players hunter clothing from furs or hides.

shops.title: Daga's Scimitar Smithy
shops.notes: Daga's Scimitar Smithy is a Scimitar Stall and the only store in Old School RuneScape to sell the dragon scimitar (for the price of 100,000 coins ). It is found on Ape Atoll and is near the rune stall . The shop is owned by the monkey trader, Daga . As with all of the facilities on Marim , players n

shops.title: Dal's General Ogre Supplies
shops.notes: Dal's General Ogre Supplies is a general store in Gu'Tanoth owned by an ogre trader named Dal . Dal is the only ogre trader in the area that allows players to trade with him, and accessing the shop requires starting the Watchtower quest.

shops.title: Dancing Donkey Inn
shops.notes: The Dancing Donkey Inn is a small bar found in south-eastern Varrock . Chancy , Hops , and Da Vinci , non-player characters who are involved in the Biohazard quest , are found there. The bar sells beer for 2 coins each.

shops.title: Dargaud's Bow and Arrows.
shops.notes: Dargaud's Bow and Arrows is a shop where Dargaud the Bow and Arrow salesman sells arrow shafts , arrows and arrowheads up to runite, as well as shortbows . He will also buy brutal arrows up to runite. His shop is located in the Ranging Guild .

shops.title: Darkmeyer General Store
shops.notes: Darkmeyer General Store is a store located in Darkmeyer , owned by Drasdan Ranor . Sins of the Father must be completed to access this store and you must be wearing the Vyre noble outfit . After The Blood Moon Rises , vyre noble clothing is no longer required. It is one of four stores in Darkmeyer,

shops.title: Darkmeyer Lantern Shop
shops.notes: Darkmeyer Lantern Shop is a store located in Darkmeyer , owned by Grinka Krast . It sells a variety of light sources . Sins of the Father must be completed to access this store and you must be wearing the Vyre noble outfit . After The Blood Moon Rises , vyre noble clothing is no longer required. It

shops.title: Darkmeyer Meat Shop
shops.notes: Darkmeyer Meat Shop is a store located in Darkmeyer , owned by Lenyig Karna . It sells a variety of raw meats. Sins of the Father must be completed to access this store and you must be wearing the Vyre noble outfit . After The Blood Moon Rises , vyre noble clothing is no longer required. It is one o

shops.title: Darkmeyer Seamstress
shops.notes: Darkmeyer Seamstress is a store located in Darkmeyer , owned by Varrian Sobak . It sells vyre noble clothing in several different variants, all of which protect players from being attacked within Darkmeyer when worn. shops.title: Darren's Wilderness Cape Shop.
shops.notes: Darren's Wilderness Cape Shop is a shop located around East of the Wilderness Agility Course and owned by Darren . It sells the 4 variety of team capes.

shops.title: Daryl's Ranging Surplus
shops.notes: Daryl's Ranging Surplus is an archery shop in Shayzien , just east of the Shayzien Administration building. It is run by Daryl .

shops.title: Davon's Amulet Store.
shops.notes: Davon's Amulet Store is a jewellery store in Brimhaven , owned by Davon . It stocks enchanted gem amulets , as well as holy symbols . It has a higher buying price and lower selling price to players wearing Karamja gloves 1 or higher.

shops.title: Dead Man's Chest
shops.notes: The Dead Man's Chest is a bar in Brimhaven (located in northern Karamja ). Players can buy grog for 3 coins and Karamjan rum for 27 coins from the Bartender . It also plays a role in Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl miniquest , in which the player must drink Supergrog. There are some beer and empty beer g

shops.title: Deadman Reward Store
shops.notes: The Deadman Reward Store is a store run by Nigel in the Lumbridge graveyard. He sells and buys rewards from Deadman: Armageddon and Deadman: Annihilation in exchange for Deadman Points . The Deadman Points balance is separate for both main game and Deadman Mode, which means that they can be spent on

shops.title: Death (shop)
shops.notes: Death is a shop located in Death's Office . It is run by the eponymous entity and sells escape crystals .

shops.title: Deepfin Inn
shops.notes: Deepfin Inn is a pub located in Deepfin Point , ran by the innkeeper Brikka . The shop has an infinite stock of alcohol and select food items. It is currently the closest shop to a bank that has an infinite stock of wine.

shops.title: Deepfin Point Ore Exchange
shops.notes: Deepfin Point Ore Exchange is a mining shop in Deepfin Point run by Korgan .

shops.title: Diango's Toy Store
shops.notes: Diango's Toy Store is located in Draynor Village market, run by Diango next to his Toy Stall . Many holiday events are centred around Diango and his store. Players who have lost a non-tradeable holiday item can visit this store to have it replaced free of charge.

shops.title: Dodgy Mike's Second Hand Clothing.
shops.notes: Dodgy Mike's Second Hand Clothing is a store in Mos Le'Harmless , run by Mike . It sells pirate boots , pirate bandanas , stripy pirate shirts , and pirate leggings .

shops.title: Dom Onion's Reward Shop
shops.notes: Dom Onion's Reward Shop is the rewards shop for the Nightmare Zone minigame , accessed through the "Rewards chest" near Dominic Onion at the minigame's entrance. At the rewards shop, players can use reward points earned in the Nightmare Zone to buy Resources , Upgrades , and Benefits .

shops.title: Dommik's Crafting Store.
shops.notes: Dommik's Crafting Store is a Crafting supplies store owned by Dommik located in north-eastern Al Kharid . It is a convenient place to buy Crafting supplies due to its close proximity to a bank and a tanner .

shops.title: Dorgesh-Kaan General Supplies
shops.notes: Dorgesh-Kaan General Supplies is a general store located in middle of the city of Dorgesh-Kaan . It is run by Lurgon who is distinguished from other goblins and merchants by his distinctive hat.

shops.title: Dragon Inn
shops.notes: The Dragon Inn is the only bar in Yanille . It is located in the south-west of the city, between the Hunter store and a small lake. shops.title: Draynor Seed Market
shops.notes: The Draynor Seed Market is a shop in Draynor Village owned by Olivia that sells a variety of seeds . Players can buy goods from Olivia or steal from the seed stall located nearby.

shops.title: Drogo's Mining Emporium.
shops.notes: Drogo's Mining Emporium is located in the Dwarven Mines , run by Drogo . Although labelled as a mining shop, it only sells hammers and bronze pickaxes . It does provide a place for players to sell their ores or bars , but it is relatively unpopular due to its inconvenient location.

shops.title: Durrik's Goods
shops.notes: Durrik's Goods is a general store in the Deepfin Mine on Deepfin Point run by Durrik . The shop sells a variety of uncommon items, some of which are not sold in any other shops such as flax , blue dragon scales , and a rune warhammer (notable for its use in a hard clue step ). Aside from offering th

shops.title: Dusuri's Star Shop
shops.notes: Dusuri's Star Shop is a store owned by Dusuri , who can be found by the Mining Guild entrance in Falador . Items in the store can only be bought with stardust .

shops.title: Dwarven shopping store
shops.notes: The Dwarven shopping store is a general store run by a dwarf in the Dwarven Mine . It is almost never visited, mainly because of its location; there are many general stores nearby (such as the ones in Falador or Edgeville ) which are much easier to reach.

shops.title: Dye shop
shops.notes: Dye shops are a type of store sparsely dotted over Gielinor . The stores are represented by a icon. Dye shops sell various hues of dyes , and may also occasionally stock crafting items used in the fashioning of garments. There are three regular dye shops in Old School RuneScape , and three that are

shops.title: Dyes to Die For
shops.notes: Dyes to Die For is a dye shop ran by Xochitl . It is located in Tal Teklan and sells multitude of dyes directly for coins without requiring ingredients.

shops.title: Edgeville General Store
shops.notes: The Edgeville General Store is a general store located in Edgeville .

shops.title: Edmond's Wilderness Cape Shop.
shops.notes: Edmond's Wilderness Cape Shop is a shop located between the bandit camp mining site and lava maze in the Wilderness and owned by Edmond . It sells the 8 variety of team capes .

shops.title: Edward's Wilderness Cape Shop.
shops.notes: Edward's Wilderness Cape Shop is a shop located in north-eastern Wilderness , near the Rogues' Castle and is owned by Edward . It sells the 5 variety of team capes.

shops.title: Efaritay's Supplies
shops.notes: Efaritay's Supplies is a shop run by Efaritay Hallow in Castle Drakan after the completion of The Blood Moon Rises .

shops.title: Elder Blunn's Spear and Shield Stall
shops.notes: Elder Blunn's Spear and Shield Stall is a weapon shop run by Elder Blunn in the Summer Shore .

shops.title: Elder Coco's Crafting Stall
shops.notes: Edler Coco's Crafting Stall is a crafting shop run by Elder Coco in the Summer Shore . As well as crafting supplies, the stall also sells gems . It is repaired from its broken state during the Troubled Tortugans quest.

shops.title: Elder Krill's Fishing Stall
shops.notes: Elder Krill's Fishing Stall is a fishing shop run by Elder Krill in the Summer Shore .

shops.title: Elder Raley's Herblore Stall
shops.notes: Elder Raley's Herblore Stall is a herblore shop in the Summer Shore . Despite the shop's name, it is not run by Elder Raley ; instead, it is run by Mag , his apprentice. [ 1 ]

shops.title: Elder Reggle's Farming Shop
shops.notes: Elder Reggle's Farming Shop is a farming shop run by Elder Reggle on the east coast of The Great Conch .

shops.title: Elder Strom's Hunting Stall
shops.notes: Elder Strom's Hunting Stall is a Hunter shop run by Elder Strom in the Summer Shore .

shops.title: Elgan's Exceptional Staffs!
shops.notes: Elgan's Exceptional Staffs is a staff shop run by Elgan on the west side of Prifddinas .

shops.title: Emelio's Kebab Shop
shops.notes: Emelio's Kebab Shop is a kebab shop where player can buy Varlamorian kebabs for 2 coins each. This shop is unlocked after completing the Meat and Greet quest , where the player helps Emelio in getting the ingredients for the kebabs.

shops.title: Etceteria Fish
shops.notes: Etceteria Fish is a Fish stall located in Etceteria and is owned by the Etceterian Fishmonger . It sells fishing equipment and buys raw fish.

shops.title: Events Reward Shop
shops.notes: The Events Reward Shop is a store run by Nevet north of the Grand Exchange . She sells rewards from Community Events in exchange for the points earned within the events. Nevet is present on free-to-play worlds, but her shop can only be accessed by members after speaking to her once and asking what s

shops.title: Fairy Fixit's Fairy Enchantment
shops.notes: Fairy Fixit's Fairy Enchantment is located by the Zanaris fairy ring . It is run by Fairy Fixit . Accessing this shop requires completion of Fairytale II - Cure a Queen .

shops.title: Falador General Store
shops.notes: The Falador General Store mainly consists of useful low level items. It is the first building on the west side when entering through the north gate. The ground floor of the general store contains the shop keeper and the shop assistant .

shops.title: Falador Party Room
shops.notes: The Party Room is a building in north-east Falador , primarily used by players to host drop parties . The Party Room functions on all worlds , but world 305 is marked as the official world in the World Switcher . Worlds 301 and 302 also are popular choices for drop parties in the Party Room.

shops.title: Fancy Clothes Store
shops.notes: The Fancy Clothes Store is a shop in south-eastern Varrock . It is owned and run by Asyff . The shop sells needles and thread and different kinds of clothes such as gloves , boots , capes , and hats . The store is also one of the places where players can obtain hunter clothing , through the Custom F

shops.title: Farmer Gricoller's Rewards
shops.notes: Farmer Gricoller's Rewards is the rewards shop for the Tithe Farm minigame , accessed by talking to Farmer Gricoller at the minigame's entrance. At the rewards shop, players can use the points earned in the minigame to purchase helpful items and upgrades for training Farming .

shops.title: Farming shops
shops.notes: Farming shops are a type of store throughout Gielinor . The stores are represented by a icon. The majority of farming shops sell tools that players need to start Farming , while some sell seeds. There are 13 Farming shops in Old School RuneScape . Most are located near an allotment farming patch .

shops.title: Farming Supplies
shops.location: Any Group of Advanced Gardeners member
shops.notes: Farming Supplies is a shop accessed via any member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners , who are found in various farming patches throughout the world.

shops.title: Faustus' Fruit and Veg
shops.notes: Faustus' Fruit and Veg is a food shop in Aldarin run by Faustus . It is notable for having stock of grapes used for making wine a common way of training cooking. This is the only shop with grapes aside from the Culinaromancer's Chest .

shops.title: Fernahei's Fishing Hut.
shops.notes: Fernahei's Fishing Hut is a fishing shop in Shilo Village run by Fernahei . The shop is filled with items related to fly Fishing , which is what Shilo Village is most popular with players for aside from the highest level Slayer Master , Duradel . It is common for players preparing to begin fly Fishi

shops.title: Fight Arena Bar
shops.location: South-western corner of the Fight Arena
shops.notes: The Fight Arena Bar is a single-floored pub located in the south-western corner of the Fight Arena . The pub heavily relies on the Arena for its business, as it draws many customers ranging from spectators to guards.

shops.title: Filamina's Wares
shops.notes: Filamina's Wares is a staff shop run by Filamina located in the house west of the bar in Arceuus .

shops.title: Fine Fashions
shops.notes: Fine Fashions is a store in the Grand Tree that is owned by Rometti . He can be found north-east on the 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] . He sells an assortment of gnome robes sets in five pastel colours. These colours are pink, green, blue, cream, and turquoise.

shops.title: Fishing Guild Shop.
shops.notes: The Fishing Guild Shop is a store located in the Fishing Guild , owned by Roachey . It sells fishing bait and feathers , and will buy fish from players. The guild requires 68 Fishing to enter.

shops.title: Fishing shops
shops.notes: Fishing shops are a type of store found throughout RuneScape. The stores are represented by a . Fishing shops sell fishing equipment, fishing bait , feathers , and raw fish.

shops.title: Flakes 'n' Flotsam
shops.notes: Flakes 'n' Flotsam is a shop run by the Spirit Angler in the Ruins of Unkah who watches over the Tempoross reward pool . The shop sells two of the unique Tempoross rewards for spirit flakes .

shops.title: Floria's Fashion
shops.notes: Floria's Fashion is a clothes shop in Civitas illa Fortis . It is run by Floria and stocks various skirts, capes, and aprons along with leather gloves and boots.

shops.title: Flosi's Fishmongers
shops.notes: Flosi's Fishmongers is a fish shop, located in north-eastern Jatizso . The shop specialises in raw seafood, which is one of the town's major resources. As the store name suggests, the owner is Flosi Dalksson . The store shares a building with Keepa Kettilon's store , which sells the cooked versions

shops.title: Flying Horse Inn
shops.notes: The Flying Horse Inn is a bar found north of Ardougne Castle , in the north-western part of East Ardougne . The bartender sells beer to thirsty adventurers for two coins per pint, and there are several small rooms to rest in upstairs (though these are non-functional).

shops.title: Flynn's Mace Market.
shops.notes: Flynn's Mace Market is a mace shop owned by Flynn in Falador . It is located between the Falador General Store and the Hairdresser in the north-western part of the city. Using the spin emote in this shop is required for the Spin at Flynn's Mace Shop beginner clue step.

shops.title: Food shops
shops.notes: Food shops are a type of shop throughout Gielinor . The stores are represented by a icon. Food shops sell a variety of foods , drinks , and other related items. There are 19 Food shops in Old School RuneScape .

shops.title: Food Store
shops.notes: The Food Store , operated by Wydin , sells a variety of fresh food , and is located in Port Sarim . It plays a notable role in the Pirate's Treasure quest - it is the drop off point between Karamja and Asgarnia to find the otherwise illegal beverage Karamjan rum , after smuggling it from Karamja.

shops.title: Forester's Arms
shops.notes: Forester's Arms is the tavern in Seers' Village . The place is featured in Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl , selling a Liverbane Ale for 18 coins ; the ale temporarily lowers Attack , Defence , Fletching , Firemaking , and Woodcutting by 6 levels, so don't plan to pursue those skills after running the ba

shops.title: Forestry Shop
shops.notes: The Forestry Shop is the shop for Forestry rewards, run by the Friendly Forester in Draynor Village , Seers' Village , Prifddinas , and Nemus Retreat , where players can purchase several unique rewards with their anima-infused bark and logs. Players (excluding Ultimate Ironmen) can sell the cape pou

shops.title: Fortis Baker's Stall
shops.notes: The Fortis Baker's Stall is a bakery stall in the bazaar within Civitas illa Fortis . It is run by the baker and stocks cake , bread , and chocolate slices .

shops.title: Fortis Blacksmith
shops.notes: The Fortis Blacksmith is a sword shop in Civitas illa Fortis that sells various metal armour and weapons . It is run by the blacksmith .

shops.title: Fortis Fur Stall
shops.notes: The Fortis Fur Stall is a fur shop in the bazaar within Civitas illa Fortis . It is run by the Fur Merchant , and stocks bear , grey wolf , and jaguar furs .

shops.title: Fortis Gem Stall
shops.notes: The Fortis Gem Stall is a gem shop in the bazaar within Civitas illa Fortis . It is run by the gem merchant , and stocks cut sapphires , emeralds , and rubies .

shops.title: Fortis General Store
shops.notes: The Fortis General Store is a general store in Civitas illa Fortis . It is run by the shopkeeper , and stocks a variety of common goods.

shops.title: Fortis Silk Stall
shops.notes: The Fortis Silk Stall is a silk shop in the bazaar within Civitas illa Fortis . It is run by the silk merchant , and stocks needles , thread , and silk .

shops.title: Fortis Spice Stall
shops.notes: The Fortis Spice Stall is a spice shop in the bazaar within Civitas illa Fortis . It is run by the Spice Merchant , and stocks knives , spice , and garlic .

shops.title: Fossil Island General Store
shops.notes: Fossil Island General Store is located in the Museum Camp on Fossil Island . It is run by a Shop keeper .

shops.title: Frankie's Fishing Emporium
shops.notes: Frankie's Fishing Emporium is a food shop run by Frankie in the south-east corner of Port Piscarilius which sells raw fish .

shops.title: Fremennik Fish Monger
shops.notes: Fremennik Fish Monger is a fish stall owned by the Rellekka Fish monger . It sells fishing equipment and buys raw fish. The Fremennik Trials must be completed to access the store.

shops.title: Fremennik Fur Trader
shops.notes: Fremennik Fur Trader is a Fur stall shop owned by the Rellekkan fur trader . It can be accessed by trading the fur trader, who keeps his stock on two stalls in Rellekka marketplace. The Fremennik Trials must be completed to access the store.

shops.title: Frenita's Cookery Shop.
shops.notes: Frenita's Cookery Shop is a Cooking shop in Yanille run by Frenita . There is also a range , sink , and churn inside the building and dairy cows just north of Yanille.

shops.title: Frincos' Fabulous Herb Store.
shops.notes: Frincos' Fabulous Herb Store is a Herblore shop on Entrana . Frincos sells eyes of newt and vials both individually and in packs. He also sells pestle and mortars . His shop contains a sink and two vial respawns. The shop is also next to a hops patch .

shops.title: Funch's Fine Groceries
shops.notes: Funch's Fine Groceries is a shop owned by Heckel Funch in the Grand Tree . It sells the food supplies and equipment needed to make gnome cocktails . The store is located on the east side of the Grand Tree's 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] , east of Blurberry's Bar.

shops.title: Fur Merchant
shops.notes: The Fur Merchant is the owner of the Fortis Fur Stall , found in the north-west corner of the bazaar in Civitas illa Fortis .

shops.title: Fur traders
shops.notes: Fur traders are a type of store found in Old School RuneScape . The stores are represented by an icon. Fur traders buy and sell different types of furs .

shops.title: Gabooty's Tai Bwo Wannai Cooperative.
shops.notes: Gabooty's Tai Bwo Wannai Cooperative is a store located in Tai Bwo Wannai , owned by Gabooty . It sells machetes and villager clothing , and will buy semi-precious gems and gout tubers . Gabooty also runs Gabooty's Tai Bwo Wannai Drinky Store .

shops.title: Gabooty's Tai Bwo Wannai Drinky Store.
shops.notes: Gabooty's Tai Bwo Wannai Drinky Store is a store located in Tai Bwo Wannai , owned by Gabooty . It purchases gnome cocktails , apparently due to the gnome pilot who crashed nearby the village. Gabooty also runs Gabooty's Tai Bwo Wannai Cooperative .

shops.title: Gaius' Two Handed Shop.
shops.notes: Gaius' Two Handed Shop is a shop in Taverley owned by Gaius that has a variety of two-handed swords ranging from bronze to adamant. This store does not sell the rune or dragon two-handed sword. It can be used as an easy source for the adamant two-handed sword needed for a hard emote clue scroll .

shops.title: Garden Centre
shops.notes: Garden Centre is a store located in Falador Park and the Farming Guild , owned by the garden supplier . It sells bagged plants that are necessary to create flora in player-owned houses .

shops.title: Garlic Cocktail Supply
shops.notes: Garlic Cocktail Supply is a store run by the werewolf in what was once Lord Mischa Myrmel 's home, after completion of The Blood Moon Rises . It only sells garlic cocktails , which when kept in the inventory causes vyrewatch sentinels to become aggressive to the player. They have no effect on other

shops.title: Gem Merchant (Civitas illa Fortis)
shops.notes: The Gem Merchant is the owner of the Fortis Gem Stall , found in the south-west corner of the bazaar in Civitas illa Fortis .

shops.title: Gem shops
shops.notes: Gem shops are a type of store throughout Gielinor . The stores are represented by a icon. Gem shops sell gems . There are twelve gem shops in total throughout Old School RuneScape .

shops.title: Gem Trader.
shops.notes: Gem Trader is a gem shop run by the Gem trader in northern Al Kharid . It is a stall, but cannot be stolen from using the Thieving skill , unlike the gem stalls in Keldagrim , Ardougne , and Mor Ul Rek .

shops.title: General store
shops.notes: The general store is a type of shop placed in many locations in Gielinor . Unlike specialty shops , general stores usually accept all tradeable items, making them a useful place to sell miscellaneous goods that do not have a dedicated store. General stores are identified on the map by a pot icon . M

shops.title: General Store (Canifis)
shops.notes: The Canifis General Store is located in north-western Canifis and is owned by Fidelio . Its wares are double the price of other general stores, and it always offers to buy items at the lowest price (as if the store has a full stock of the item). However, unlike other stores, the Canifis General Stor

shops.title: Gerrant's Fishy Business.
shops.notes: Gerrant's Fishy Business is located in Port Sarim . The shop sells Fishing supplies. It is run by Gerrant .

shops.title: Gianne's Restaurant
shops.notes: Gianne's Restaurant is a food store located on the west side of the 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] of the Grand Tree , owned by Aluft Gianne snr. and operated by the Gnome Waiters . It sells premade gnome food , which cannot be used for the Gnome Restaurant minigame.

shops.title: Giants' Foundry Reward Shop
shops.notes: The Giants' Foundry Reward Shop is the rewards shop for the Giants' Foundry Smithing minigame, accessed by talking to Kovac . At the rewards shop, players can use reputation earned by completing commissions to purchase helpful items for training Smithing , both in and out of the Foundry, as well as

shops.title: Grace's Graceful Clothing
shops.notes: Grace's Graceful Clothing is a clothing store owned by Grace , who lives in the Rogues' Den under The Toad and Chicken Inn in Burthorpe . It is the only store that sells pieces of the graceful outfit , which are bought with marks of grace . Wearing the complete outfit will reduce one's weight by 25

shops.title: Grand Tree Groceries
shops.notes: Grand Tree Groceries is a shop run by Hudo in the Grand Tree . It sells the food supplies and equipment needed to make gnome food . It is located on the 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] in the north-western corner of the Grand Tree .

shops.title: Green Gemstone Gems
shops.notes: Green Gemstone Gems is a Gem stall in Keldagrim run by Hervi , who is a member of The Green Gemstone faction of the Dwarven Consortium . The shop sells a variety of gems that can be used to make jewellery with the Crafting skill.

shops.title: Greengrocer of Miscellania
shops.notes: Greengrocer of Miscellania is a vegetable stall located in Miscellania and is owned by the Miscellanian Greengrocer . It sells common vegetables.

shops.title: Grud's Herblore Stall.
shops.notes: Grud's Herblore Stall is a shop in Gu'Tanoth that sells herblore ingredients. It is run by an ogre called Grud .

shops.title: Grum's Gold Exchange.
shops.notes: Grum's Gold Exchange is a jewellery shop located in Port Sarim and operated by Grum . The store buys and sells many kinds of unenchanted jewellery , though it does not deal in dragonstone , onyx , or zenyte jewellery or bracelets .

shops.title: Guinevere's Dyes
shops.notes: Guinevere's Dyes is a dye shop run by Guinevere on the south-west side of Prifddinas .

shops.title: Gulluck and Sons
shops.location: Grand Tree , 2 nd floor [ UK ] 3 rd floor [ US ]
shops.notes: Gulluck and Sons is a weapons shop owned and run by the gnomish trader Gulluck and his sons (though his sons do not appear in-game) on the 2 nd floor [ UK ] 3 rd floor [ US ] of the Grand Tree , the large keep of the Tree Gnome Stronghold . The shop is marked as a sword shop on the map even though G

shops.title: Gunslik's Assorted Items
shops.notes: Gunslik's Assorted Items is a general store in Keldagrim run by Gunslik . It is located in the southern compartment of the West Consortium building, on the ground floor.

shops.title: Gwyn's Mining Emporium
shops.notes: Gwyn's Mining Emporium is a pickaxe shop run by Gwyn on the south-east side of Prifddinas .

shops.title: Hair of the Dog
shops.notes: The Hair of the Dog tavern is located in Canifis , south of the town square. It is run by Roavar .

shops.title: Hamab's Crafting Emporium
shops.notes: Hamab's Crafting Emporium is a Crafting stall run by Hamab that can be found on Ape Atoll and therefore can only be safely accessed while a monkey greegree is equipped or after completion of Monkey Madness II. The m'speak amulet is needed if talking to Hamab to open the shop, but not needed if using

shops.title: Happy Heroes' H'emporium.
shops.location: 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] of the Heroes' Guild
shops.notes: Happy Heroes' H'emporium is a shop run by Helemos , who resides within the Heroes' Guild . As such, the shop can only be accessed after completion of the Heroes' Quest . This is one out of the two shops (the other being the Myths' Guild Weaponry shop ) that sells the dragon battleaxe and dragon mace

shops.title: Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum'.
shops.notes: Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum' is a pub owned by Joe , located in the pirate town of Mos Le'Harmless . The shop sells various alcoholic beverages. The Other Inn is more popular, however, due to more personalities being present there and being in a more prominent location. The upper floors of both pubs

shops.title: Harry's Fishing Shop.
shops.notes: Harry's Fishing Shop is located in eastern Catherby . It is run by Harry . It is a convenient location for players because it is close to many Fishing spots. Players can sell their unwanted fish here.

shops.title: Hefin Inn
shops.notes: The Hefin Inn is a bar and an inn found on the north side of Prifddinas . Beer ("Just a beer"), Cider ("Something a bit fruity"), Stew ("Something to eat") and Elven dawn ("Some kind of local specialty") are all purchasable from Eira .

shops.title: Helmet Shop.
shops.notes: The Helmet Shop is a shop run by Peksa located in central Barbarian Village . The shop offers medium and full helmets ranging from bronze to adamant , with the exception of black helms. It is the only shop in the Barbarian Village. The shop also contains a permanent fire .

shops.title: Helmet shops
shops.notes: Helmet shops are a type of store throughout Gielinor . The stores are represented by a icon. Helmet shops sell assorted helmets , such as medium helmets , full helmets and Fremennik helmets . There are 3 dedicated helmet shops in Old School RuneScape .

shops.title: Henderson's Catch of the Day
shops.notes: Henderson's Catch of the Day is a Fishing shop run by Henderson on the Pandemonium .

shops.title: Hendor's Awesome Ores
shops.notes: Hendor's Awesome Ores is a mining shop , run by Hendor , in the Mining Guild 's free-to-play area that sells ores .

shops.title: Herblore shops
shops.notes: Herblore shops are a type of store throughout Gielinor . The stores are represented by a icon. Herblore shops sell items used in the Herblore skill. There are 7 stores in Old School RuneScape .

shops.title: Herquin's Gems.
shops.notes: Herquin's Gems is located on the west side of Falador , just south of the west bank . It is owned by Herquin .

shops.title: Hickton's Archery Emporium.
shops.notes: Hickton's Archery Emporium is located in central Catherby . Players with 99 Fletching may visit the store to buy the Fletching Cape of Accomplishment for 99,000 coins. Unlike most archery stores, Hickton's Archery Emporium stocks arrowtips for players who wish to create their own arrows using the Fl

shops.title: Honest Jimmy's House of Stuff
shops.notes: Honest Jimmy's House of Stuff is a shop that sells rewards for the Trouble Brewing minigame , costing pieces of eight . It is run by Honest Jimmy . It is located on the far east of Mos Le'Harmless . By talking to Honest Jimmy, players can also buy a medium clue scroll (referred to by Jimmy as "map")

shops.title: Horvik's Armour Shop.
shops.notes: Horvik's Armour Shop is located near central Varrock . It is operated by Horvik , and he specialises in selling chainbodies and platebodies . The shop is unusual because the building also houses an anvil . This makes it a convenient place for a player to sell armour as they smith it.

shops.title: Huito's Herbal Supplies
shops.notes: Huito's Herbal Supplies is a shop in Cam Torum owned by Huito that sells Herblore supplies.

shops.title: Hunter shops
shops.notes: Hunter shops are a type of store throughout Gielinor that sell items used in the Hunter skill. The stores are represented by a icon. There are 4 Hunter shops in Old School RuneScape .

shops.title: Ian's Wilderness Cape Shop.
shops.notes: Ian's Wilderness Cape Shop is a shop located near the Forgotten Cemetery and owned by Ian . It sells the 2 variety of team capes.

shops.title: Ifaba's General Store
shops.notes: Ifaba's General Store is a general store run by Ifaba . It is located in Marim , on Ape Atoll . Unlike other general stores, it does not sell some usual items others would, such as a chisel . Ifaba also owns the General Stall which can be stolen from with level 5 Thieving .

shops.title: Imia's Supplies
shops.notes: Imia's Supplies is a hunter shop in the Hunter Guild run by Imia . Like all amenities in the guild, level 46 Hunter is required to access her wares.

shops.title: Initiate Temple Knight Armoury
shops.notes: The Initiate Temple Knight Armoury is a store ran by Sir Tiffy Cashien , who is sat in the Falador Park . Pieces of the Initiate armour set can be purchased from Sir Tiffy upon completion of the Recruitment Drive quest, when the player character is first inducted into the order of the Temple Knights

shops.title: Iorwerth's Arms
shops.notes: Iorwerth's Arms is a weapons shop run by Celyn on the south side of Prifddinas .

shops.title: Irksol (shop)
shops.notes: Irksol is a store run by Irksol in the Zanaris marketplace. The shop only sells ruby rings , and it is decorated with fairy market stalls .

shops.title: Ishmael's Fish He Sells
shops.notes: Ishmael's Fish He Sells is a Fishing shop run by Ishmael in the Ruins of Unkah that sells Fishing supplies and raw fish .

shops.title: Island Fishmonger
shops.notes: Island Fishmonger is a Fish stall located in Miscellania and is owned by the Miscellanian Fishmonger . It sells fishing equipment and buys raw fish.

shops.title: Island Greengrocer
shops.notes: Island Greengrocer is a vegetable stall located in Etceteria and is owned by the Etceterian Greengrocer . It sells common vegetables.

shops.title: Ivan's Supplies
shops.notes: Ivan's Supplies is a store run by Ivan Strom in Meiyerditch , in the Myreque hideout in the basement of Old Man Ral 's house, after the completion of Sins of the Father .

shops.title: Iwan's Maces
shops.notes: Iwan's Maces is a mace shop run by Iwan on the north side of Prifddinas . Iwan advertises his shop in Iwan's flyer , an otherwise useless item obtained by doing poorly in The Gauntlet .

shops.title: Jamila's Craft Stall.
shops.notes: Jamila's Craft Stall is a crafting shop owned by Jamila located in the city of Sophanem . To access Sophanem, the quest Icthlarin's Little Helper must be completed. Unlike other crafting stalls , the craft stall by Jamila cannot be stolen from.

shops.title: Jatix's Herblore Shop.
shops.notes: Jatix's Herblore Shop is a shop in Taverley owned by Jatix that sells Herblore supplies. This shop sells empty vials and eyes of newt in packs.

shops.title: Jennifer's General Supplies
shops.notes: Jennifer's General Supplies is a shop owned by Jennifer . It is located east of bank in Shayzien .

shops.title: Jiminua's Jungle Store.
shops.notes: Jiminua's Jungle Store is a general store that sells many useful items for those adventuring in the Karamjan jungle, such as antipoison , pickaxes , machetes , and axes . It is also notable for being one of the few places to obtain both charcoal and papyrus . Because of the items it stocks, this sho

shops.title: Jolly Boar Inn
shops.notes: The Jolly Boar Inn is a two-story bar and inn located north-east of Varrock , on the southern border of the Wilderness . It contains a range and a spawn point for thread . The bartender only sells (ordinary) beer for 2 coins each.

shops.title: Jukat (shop)
shops.notes: Jukat is a store run by Jukat in Zanaris that sells dragon longswords and dragon daggers . The shop can only be accessed after completion of the Lost City quest, which also gives the player the ability to wield both dragon items. shops.title: Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing

shops.title: Karamja General Store
shops.notes: The Karamja General Store is a general store located on Karamja carrying average general store stock. The store is also able to buy items at high alch value if the user is wearing Karamja Gloves 3 or above, which implicitly makes either 100 Combat level or 99 Slayer a requirement for this perk.

shops.title: Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers.
shops.notes: Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers is a shop run by Zembo that sells beer , Karamjan rum , and jugs of wine . According to Zembo, they are all brewed locally on the island.

shops.title: Kastori Farming Supplies
shops.notes: Kastori Farming Supplies is a farming shop located in Kastori . It is run by Ameyalli and it sells farming supplies.

shops.title: Kastori General Store
shops.notes: Kastori General Store is a general store run by a shopkeeper in Kastori .

shops.title: Kebab seller
shops.notes: Kebab sellers are a type of store throughout Gielinor in which kebabs are sold, and are represented by a icon on the world map . There are 4 dedicated kebab sellers in Old School RuneScape , with Emelio selling Varlamorian kebabs rather than the common kebab.

shops.title: Keepa Kettilon's store
shops.notes: Keepa Kettilon's store is a food shop , located in north-eastern Jatizso . The shop specialises in cooked seafood, which is one of the town's major resources. shops.title: Keldagrim Stonemason
shops.notes: Keldagrim Stonemason is a shop run by the Stonemason . The store is located in the western area of Keldagrim and south-east of the bar. shops.title: Keldagrim's Best Bread
shops.notes: Keldagrim's Best Bread is a bakery stall run by Randivor located in the east marketplace of Keldagrim Palace . It sells bread and cakes of different varieties.

shops.title: Kenelme's Wares
shops.notes: Kenelme's Wares is a food shop run by Kenelme located in Great Kourend 's Port Piscarilius .

shops.title: Khazard General Store
shops.notes: The Khazard General Store is a general store with two locations sharing the same stock in Port Khazard . The store has stock consistent with other general stores, as well as a few items that are unique to the Fishing Trawler minigame.

shops.title: King Narnode's Royal Seed Pods
shops.notes: King Narnode's Royal Seed Pods is a store located on the ground floor [ UK ] 1 st floor [ US ] of the Grand Tree , run by King Narnode Shareen . It can only be accessed after completion of Monkey Madness II .

shops.title: King's Axe Inn
shops.notes: The King's Axe Inn is a bar and hotel located in one of Keldagrim West's wealthiest districts, amongst a number of shops and homes. shops.title: Kjut's Kebabs
shops.notes: Kjut's Kebabs is an item store where player can buy kebabs for 1 coin each. Players must talk to Kjut and go through his dialogue in order to buy a kebab. This shop is primarily unvisited except for during the Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf quest where the player is hypnotised.

shops.title: Kourend Castle Baker's Stall.
shops.notes: Kourend Castle Baker's Stall is a Bakery stall run by a baker located in Kourend Castle . It sells bread , cakes and chocolate bars .

shops.title: Kourend Castle Gem Stall.
shops.notes: The Kourend Castle Gem Stall is a Gem stall in Kourend Castle run by a Gem merchant .

shops.title: Larry's Wilderness Cape Shop.
shops.notes: Larry's Wilderness Cape Shop is a shop located near the Graveyard of Shadows and Bone Yard and is owned by Larry . It sells the 3 variety of team capes.

shops.title: Laughing Miner Pub
shops.notes: The Laughing Miner Pub is a bar found in the eastern side of Keldagrim , near the entrance to the marketplace. It is regarded by NPCs as a dodgy, criminal-infested bar, but offers several interesting features for players.

shops.title: Leagues Reward Shop
shops.notes: The Leagues Reward Shop is a store run by the Leagues Tutor north of the Grand Exchange. They sell rewards from Old School RuneScape Leagues in exchange for points earned within the Leagues on members ' worlds. The shop owner and location changes depending on the most recent League held.

shops.title: Leenz's General Supplies
shops.notes: Leenz's General Supplies is located in Port Piscarilius . It is run by Leenz . Unlike other general stores, this shop sells both bronze nails and iron nails , and is the only shop besides the Construction supplies shop to sell them.

shops.title: Legends Guild General Store.
shops.location: 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] of Legends' Guild
shops.notes: The Legends Guild General Store is a general store located on the 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] of Legends' Guild , owned by Fionella .

shops.title: Legends Guild Shop of Useful Items.
shops.location: 2 nd floor [ UK ] 3 rd floor [ US ] of Legends' Guild (west side)
shops.notes: The Legends Guild Shop of Useful Items is a store located on the 2 nd floor [ UK ] 3 rd floor [ US ] of Legends' Guild , owned by the Guildmaster's brother, Siegfried Erkle . The shop is the only source of the Cape of Legends and Mithril seeds (except the quest reward from Waterfall Quest ).

shops.title: Leon's Prototype Crossbow.
shops.notes: Leon's Prototype Crossbow is a shop in Yanille , just east of the Dragon Inn . The shop sells the Hunters' crossbow and is managed and owned by Leon . It is located in the same building as Aleck and Aleck's Hunter Emporium.

shops.title: Leprechaun Larry's Farming Supplies.
shops.notes: Leprechaun Larry's Farming Supplies is a shop run by Leprechaun Larry on the roof of Troll Stronghold near My Arm . It sells commonly used farming equipment, as well as cocktail glasses and rocks.

shops.title: Little Shop of Horace
shops.notes: Little Shop of Horace is a general store run by Horace in Hosidius , just east of the bank .

shops.title: Lletya Archery Shop

shops.notes: Lletya General Store is a store run by Eudav , an elven proprietor in Lletya , which sells a few commonly used, inexpensive items which are typically found in every General store . The Mourning's End Part I quest needs to be started to in order to access Lletya.

shops.title: Lletya Seamstress
shops.notes: Lletya Seamstress is a store run by Oronwen , an elven proprietor in Lletya , that sells crafting items including the main six colours of dyes pre-made. Partial completion of Mourning's End Part I is required to access Lletya.

shops.title: Lliann's Wares
shops.notes: Lliann's Wares is a clothing shop run by Lliann on the west side of Prifddinas , in the Ithell district.

shops.title: Logava Gricoller's Cooking Supplies
shops.notes: Logava Gricoller's Cooking Supplies is a Fruit Stall located in Hosidius . It is run by Logava , the granddaughter of Farmer Gricoller .

shops.notes: Lovecraft's Tackle is a fishing shop in Witchaven , owned by Ezekial Lovecraft . It sells all normal fishing equipment .

shops.title: Lowe's Archery Emporium

shops.title: Lumbridge Blacksmith
shops.notes: The Lumbridge Blacksmith is a shop run by Feoras located in Lumbridge .

shops.title: Lumbridge General Store
shops.notes: The Lumbridge General Store is the general store located north of the Lumbridge Castle in Lumbridge . When new players arrive in Old School RuneScape , they start in Lumbridge and tend to have a look around, and thus the store is a popular place for new players.

shops.notes: Mount Karuulm Weapon Shop is located on top of Mount Karuulm . Owned by Leke quo Keran , it is the only shop found there.

shops.notes: Multicannon parts for sale is a store located in the dwarven industrial area of Ice Mountain , owned by Nulodion . It sells dwarf multicannon parts, ammo moulds , and the instruction manual . The Dwarf Cannon quest must be completed to access the store.

shops.notes: Mysterious Stranger is a shop located at the entrance of the Theatre of Blood . It is run by the Mysterious Stranger and sells escape crystals .

shops.title: Ned's Handmade Rope (100% Wool)
shops.notes: Ned's Handmade Rope is a rope shop owned by Ned in Draynor Village . The only item sold at this shop is rope . The shop was added in an update on 1 May 2014 to streamline the process of buying rope from Ned, though it is more expensive than buying through Ned's dialogue.

shops.title: Neil's Wilderness Cape Shop.
shops.notes: Neil's Wilderness Cape Shop is a team cape shop owned by Neil , a cape merchant in the Wilderness Bandit Camp . This shop has the 7 variety of team capes with a scarab symbol on them.

shops.title: Neitiznot supplies.
shops.notes: Neitiznot supplies is a crafting shop located in Neitiznot and owned by Jofridr Mordstatter . It sells some crafting supplies, but no chisel and no moulds . This is a great way to buy balls of wool , due to their cheap price and proximity to a bank.

shops.title: Nemus Retreat (pub)
shops.notes: Nemus Retreat is a pub located in the eponymous camp . Its bartender sells stew and a wide range of alcohol.

shops.title: Nurmof's Pickaxe Shop.
shops.notes: Nurmof's Pickaxe Shop is located in the north-west cul-de-sac of the Dwarven Mine , accessed through the alley with the anvil , south-west from the north entrance. Alternatively, a disk of returning can be used anywhere within the mine to teleport players south-west of the cul-de-sac's mouth.

shops.title: Obli's General Store.
shops.notes: Obli's General Store is a general store run by Obli in Shilo Village on Karamja . This general store has the largest stock of general stores with items varying from Machetes to Candles , and Charcoal to Spades .

shops.notes: Old Man Ral's Supplies is a store run by Old Man Ral in Meiyerditch after Ivan leaves the Myreque hideout during The Blood Moon Rises quest. The store offers the same stock as Ivan's Supplies .

shops.notes: Petrified Pete's Ore Shop is a shop found by the entrance of the Fossil Island Volcano 's mine . It uses points earned from the mine to exchange wares. The shop consists of ores, the prospector kit , and other mining byproducts.
