shops.notes: The PvP Arena Rewards shop is the Emir's Arena reward store run by Mubariz located by the entrance to the Emir's Arena.

shops.title: Quality Armour Shop
shops.notes: The Quality Armour Shop is a shop run by Saro , a dwarven blacksmith. He can be found in the south-west corner of Keldagrim (south of the Black Guard H.Q.). This building can be located on the map easily by looking for both the anvil and shield symbol within it. The shop sells multiple types of armo

shops.title: Quality Weapons Shop
shops.notes: The Quality Weapons Shop is located in north-western Keldagrim , and is owned by Santiri . It sells a mixture of metal ranged and melee weaponry that players of nearly all levels can make use of. It is also noted for being one of the very few stores that stocks the rune longsword .

shops.title: Quartermaster's Stores
shops.notes: The Quartermaster's Stores is a store located in the Tyras Camp , owned by the quartermaster . It serves as a general store , but uniquely also sells most types of metal halberds . It is one of two places to buy a dragon halberd , the other being Iorwerth's Arms . Notably, dragon halberds only becom

shops.title: Quetzacalli Gorge General Store
shops.notes: Quetzacalli Gorge General Store is a general store run by a shopkeeper in Quetzacalli Gorge .

shops.title: Raetul and Co's Cloth Store.
shops.notes: Raetul and Co's Cloth Store is a store in Sophanem that sells thread , desert clothes and other materials. The quest Icthlarin's Little Helper must be completed to access Sophanem. This store can only be accessed through conversation with Raetul who can be found in front of Siamun 's establishment (

shops.title: Ramarno's Shard Exchange
shops.notes: Ramarno's Shard Exchange is a shop run by Ramarno in the centre of the Ruins of Camdozaal . In the shop players can trade Barronite shards for various upgrades used inside the ruins. Ramarno explains that he burns the Barronite shards in the Sacred Forge , which then powers several charms throughout

shops.title: Ranael's Super Skirt Store.
shops.notes: Ranael's Super Skirt Store is located in south-eastern Al Kharid . It sells plateskirts up to adamant . It is run by Ranael .

shops.title: Ranging Guild Ticket Exchange
shops.notes: The Ranging Guild Ticket Exchange is an archery shop in the Ranging Guild that sells Ranged equipment in exchange for Archery tickets .

shops.title: Rasolo the Wandering Merchant
shops.notes: Rasolo the Wandering Merchant is a store run by Rasolo . The store is located west of the Fishing Guild and south of the Baxtorian Falls . The shop stocks a varied assortment of items, most notably a dragon dagger . Ironmen attempting to purchase the dragon dagger early should be aware that the drag

shops.title: Rat & Bat
shops.notes: The Rat & Bat is the bar located in south-east Slepe . This bar does not sell ordinary beer , however it does sell bloody bracers for the price of 99 coins. It is the only bar where bloody bracers can be acquired.

shops.title: Ratpit bar (Keldagrim)
shops.notes: The Keldagrim Ratpit Bar is a bar tended by Rauborn in the rat pit under Keldagrim . It is accessed through a staircase in the Laughing Miner . Here, players can buy stew for 20 coins each and beer for 2 coins each. Many dwarves come here to buy drinks.

shops.title: Ratpit bar (Port Sarim)
shops.notes: The Port Sarim Ratpit Bar is a bar tended by the barman in the rat pit under Port Sarim . It is accessed through a manhole between Gerrant's Fishy Business and Grum's Gold Exchange . Here, players can buy stew for 20 coins each and beer for 2 coins each.

shops.title: Ratpit bar (Varrock)
shops.notes: The Varrock Ratpit Bar is a bar tended by the barman in the rat pit under Varrock . It is accessed through a manhole between in the south-eastern part of the city, just north of the Dancing Donkey Inn . Here, players can buy stew for 20 coins each and beer for 2 coins each.

shops.title: Razmire Builders Merchants.
shops.notes: Razmire Builders Merchants is a store with building supplies that is located in Mort'ton and run by Razmire Keelgan . The supplies it stocks are used for the Shades of Mort'ton minigame nearby.

shops.title: Razmire General Store.
shops.notes: The Razmire General Store is a general store located in Mort'ton , and is run by Razmire Keelgan . In addition to the standard general store items, there is a stock of Olive oil as well as the Flamtaer hammer . Access to this general store is unlocked during the Shades of Mort'ton quest.

shops.title: Regath's Wares
shops.notes: Regath's Wares is a general store run by Regath located in Arceuus . Despite being labelled on the map as a general store, the stock is more appropriate for a magic shop .

shops.title: Reldak's Leather Armour
shops.notes: Reldak's Leather Armour is a shop near the eastern middle part of the Dorgesh-Kaan marketplace which sells frog-leather armour . It is owned and run by a Dorgeshuun Cave Goblin called Reldak next to his Armour stall .

shops.title: Rellekka Longhall Bar
shops.notes: The Rellekka Longhall Bar is a bar found in the Rellekka longhall run by Thora the Barkeep . It sells beer by the glass, tankard , or keg . Some NPCs located in the bar are the focus of the quest The Fremennik Trials , in which the player must enlist the support of Manni the Reveller and begin the q

shops.title: Richard's Farming shop.
shops.notes: Richard's Farming shop is a farming shop at Richard's farm by the Ardougne north entrance and owned by Richard .

shops.title: Richard's Wilderness Cape Shop.
shops.notes: Richard's Wilderness Cape Shop is a shop located in Edgeville and owned by Richard . It sells the 6 variety of team capes.

shops.title: Rimmington General Store
shops.notes: The Rimmington General Store is a general store in Rimmington . It is run by the shop keeper and his assistant . The shop is most notable for being the location of Phials , who is often used in conjunction with the nearby POH portal for fast Construction and Prayer training.

shops.title: Rising Sun Inn
shops.notes: The Rising Sun Inn can be found on the west end of Falador , across from the bank. The bar is run by three barmaids: Kaylee , Emily , and Tina . All three barmaids will sell any player a wizard's mind bomb , dwarven stout , or Asgarnian ale . This bar does not sell ordinary beer . It does, however,

shops.title: Rok's Chocs Box.
shops.notes: Rok's Chocs Box is a Choc-Ice Stall located in Nardah that sells chocolate bars and choc-ice . The stall is just south-east of the fountain in the city square and directly east from the general store icon. There is no icon on the minimap for this stall.

shops.title: Rommik's Crafty Supplies.
shops.notes: Rommik's Crafty Supplies is located in Rimmington and owned by Rommik . It is a convenient place to buy Crafting supplies due to its close proximity to the Crafting Guild .

shops.title: Rufus' Meat Emporium
shops.notes: Rufus' Meat Emporium is a food shop located in Canifis , run by Rufus . Raw meat and fish can be bought and sold here.

shops.title: Rusty Anchor Inn
shops.notes: The Rusty Anchor Inn is a bar in Port Sarim , located just north of the docks.

shops.title: Salius' Armour Shop
shops.notes: Salius' Armour Shop is a platebody shop in the Salvager Overlook . It is run by Salius .

shops.title: Salvager Overlook General Store
shops.notes: The Salvager Overlook General Store is a general store located in Salvager Overlook . It is run by a sole shopkeeper .

shops.title: Sam's Wilderness Cape Shop.
shops.notes: Sam's Wilderness Cape Shop is a team cape shop owned by Sam , a cape merchant east of the Dark Warriors' Fortress in the Wilderness . This shop sells the 0 variety capes with a claw symbol on them.

shops.title: Sarah's Farming shop.
shops.notes: Sarah's Farming shop is a Farming shop at Sarah 's farm south of Falador that sells various Farming items and buys certain crops. Her shop is only available to members .

shops.title: Sawmill
shops.notes: A sawmill is a shop which facilitates the creation of planks. The sawmill operator working there can turn seven different kinds of logs into planks for a fee, and also sells Construction supplies: saws , bolts of cloth , and three kinds of nails . All sawmills share the same stock. Players can have

shops.title: Scavvo's Rune Store.
shops.notes: Scavvo's Rune Store is located on the 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] of the Champions' Guild and operated by Scavvo . This means players will need to acquire 32 quest points before they can access his shop.

shops.title: Scimitar shops
shops.notes: Scimitar shops are a type of store throughout Gielinor . The stores are represented by a icon. There are 3 dedicated scimitar shops in Old School RuneScape .

shops.title: Seb's Shipyard Supplies
shops.notes: Seb's Shipyard Supplies is a shop run by Shipwright Seb at the Shipyard . It stocks basic materials for ship construction and repair kits .

shops.title: Sebamo's Sublime Staffs
shops.notes: Sebamo's Sublime Staffs is a staff shop in Auburnvale , owned by Sebamo .

shops.title: Seddu's Adventurer's Store.
shops.notes: Seddu's Adventurer's Store is a shop in Nardah , run by Seddu . Compared to other shops, it sells items for slightly lower prices, and buys them at slightly higher prices. This makes it a somewhat popular moneymaking method to sell certain items to the shop.

shops.title: Shantay Pass Shop
shops.notes: The Shantay Pass Shop is a shop owned by Shantay in the Shantay Pass . It sells items players might need in the Kharidian Desert , such as waterskins , knives , and desert clothing .

shops.title: Shayzien Styles
shops.notes: Shayzien Styles is a clothing shop in Shayzien found east of the bank. It is run by Robyn , assistant of Osten .

shops.title: Shield shops
shops.notes: Shield shops are a type of store throughout Gielinor . The stores are represented by a icon. Shield shops sell square shields and kiteshields . There are three dedicated shield shops in Old School RuneScape .

shops.title: Shields of Mistrock
shops.notes: Shields of Mistrock is a shield shop run by Ichta , an Imcando-descendant dwarf , in Mistrock .

shops.title: Shop
shops.notes: A shop is any establishment which allows the trading of currency for an item or service, or vice versa. Shop prices may be lower or higher than the equivalent item's price on the Grand Exchange , however, due to their fixed prices, shops cannot be susceptible to the market trends of the Grand Exchan

shops.title: Shop of Distaste
shops.notes: The Shop of Distaste is a shop in the Emir's Arena , right next to the bank. All they sell is rotten tomatoes , which can be bought from the shopkeeper, Fadli , for one coin each. The rotten tomatoes can be thrown at player characters while they're fighting, but not when they are fighting you. They

shops.title: Shopkeeper (Aldarin)
shops.notes: The Shopkeeper runs Aldarin 's general store in the north-eastern part of the island.

shops.title: Shopkeeper (Auburnvale)
shops.notes: The Shopkeeper runs Auburnvale 's general store .

shops.title: Shopkeeper (Civitas illa Fortis)
shops.notes: The shopkeeper is the owner of the Fortis General Store , found north-west of the bazaar in Civitas illa Fortis .

shops.title: Shopkeeper (Outer Fortis)
shops.notes: The Shopkeeper runs the general store on the south side of Outer Fortis .

shops.title: Shopkeeper (Sunset Coast)
shops.notes: The shopkeeper is in charge of the Sunset Coast General Store .

shops.title: Sian's Ranged Weaponry
shops.notes: Sian's Ranged Weaponry is an archery shop run by Sian on the east side of Prifddinas .

shops.title: Sigmund the Merchant (shop)
shops.notes: Sigmund the Merchant is a shop run by the owner of the same name, Sigmund The Merchant . Players must be Fremenniks (completed The Fremennik Trials ) in order to trade with him. He sells various items in addition to normal general store stock.

shops.title: Silk Merchant (Civitas illa Fortis)
shops.notes: The Silk Merchant is the owner of the Fortis Silk Stall , found in the north-west corner of the bazaar in Civitas illa Fortis .

shops.title: Silk shops
shops.notes: Silk shops are a type of store found in Old School RuneScape . The stores are represented by an icon. Silk shops buy or sell silk and sometimes other items. There are five dedicated silk shops in Old School RuneScape .

shops.title: Silver Cog Silver Stall
shops.notes: The Silver Cog Silver Stall is a silver stall run by Gulldamar , a member of the Silver Cog Mining Company, part of the Mining Consortium that rules the city of Keldagrim . Gulldamar sells silver ore , silver bars , and unstrung symbols at his stall .

shops.title: Silver shops
shops.notes: Silver shops are a type of store found in Old School RuneScape . The stores are represented by an icon. Silver shops sell silver items and tools used to craft things with them.

shops.title: Simon's Wilderness Cape Shop.
shops.notes: Simon's Wilderness Cape Shop is a shop located at the Chaos Temple and owned by Simon . It sells the 9 variety of team capes .

shops.title: Skulgrimen's Battle Gear
shops.notes: Skulgrimen's Battle Gear is located in Rellekka , just north of the longhall. Skulgrimen , the store owner, and Thorvald the Warrior can be found in the building. Completion of The Fremennik Trials is required in order to access this shop.

shops.title: Skull in a Chest Inn
shops.notes: The Skull in a Chest Inn is a ruined and abandoned bar found in north-eastern Meiyerditch .

shops.title: Slayer Equipment (shop)
shops.notes: Slayer Equipment shops are run by Slayer Masters . They consist of various tools and weapons for use against Slayer monsters .

shops.title: Slayer Rewards
shops.notes: Slayer Rewards shops are run by Slayer Masters . They provide rewards to be exchanged for Slayer reward points . Purchasing each unlock and extend reward once costs 15,510 points; however, some toggleable rewards must be paid for each time they are toggled.

shops.title: Smithing Smith's Shop.
shops.notes: Smithing Smith's Shop is a store located in Mos Le'Harmless , owned by Smith . He sells scimitars up to mithril and hammers . In addition, cutlasses can be bought from him through dialogue.

shops.title: Solihib's Food Stall
shops.notes: Solihib's Food Stall is a Food Stall located on Ape Atoll . It sells monkey food such as banana stew . Prior to the completion of Monkey Madness II , the player must be in the form of a monkey (see monkey greegrees ) and wear the m'speak amulet to talk with him, but players could trade with him with

shops.title: Soul Wars Reward Shop
shops.notes: The Soul Wars Reward Shop is the Soul Wars reward store owned by Nomad located on the Isle of Souls . Players can spend their earned Zeal Tokens here for combat experience, upgrades, loot, and rewards unique to the minigame.

shops.title: Speedrunning Reward Shop
shops.notes: The Speedrunning Reward Shop is a store run by Eliza in the centre of Varrock , just north of the Varrock General Store . She sells rewards from Quest Speedrunning in exchange for points earned within the game mode on members ' worlds.

shops.title: Spice Merchant
shops.notes: The Spice Merchant is the owner of the Fortis Spice Stall , found in the south-east corner of the bazaar in Civitas illa Fortis . Players must also speak to the Spice Merchant during the Meat and Greet quest.

shops.title: Spice shops
shops.notes: Spice shops are a type of store throughout Gielinor . The stores are represented by a icon. Spice shops sell spice and gnome spice . There are 4 dedicated spice shops in Old School RuneScape .

shops.title: Spike's Spikes
shops.notes: Spike's Spikes is a shop run by Spike , located on the east side of Outer Fortis . The shop offers maces ranging from bronze to rune.

shops.title: Staff shops
shops.notes: Staff shops are a type of store throughout Gielinor . The stores are represented by a icon. There are 4 staff shops in Old School RuneScape .

shops.title: Stall
shops.notes: A stall is a stand that NPCs use to display their product. The majority of stalls can be stolen from with appropriate level in Thieving . Items sold include: silk , fur , scimitars , fish , vegetables , etc. Most types of stalls can be found in Ardougne ; however, there is also a selection in Rellek

shops.title: Stick Your Ore Inn
shops.notes: The Stick Your Ore Inn is a bar found in Mistrock , on the southern side of the island of Aldarin . The bar is run by a bartender . The bar sells steamforge brews and sun-shine not found in bars on the mainland.

shops.title: Stonecutter Supplies
shops.notes: Stonecutter Supplies is a shop run by Metla . The store is located in the Stonecutter Outpost in the south eastern part of the Avium Savannah . Most of the items stocked are solely used for Construction , and are required to construct some of the highest level items in the skill. Stonecutter Supplie

shops.title: Sulisal's Superb Fishing Store
shops.notes: Sulisal's Superb Fishing Store is a shop run by Sulisal , located in Kastori .

shops.title: Sunlight's Sanctum
shops.notes: Sunlight's Sanctum is a pub located in Aldarin . The bartender sells food and a wide range of alcohol.

shops.title: Sunset Coast General Store
shops.notes: The Sunset Coast General Store is a general store run by a Shopkeeper in the centre of the Sunset Coast .

shops.title: Supplies's Supplies
shops.notes: Supplies's Supplies is a general store in Auchrie on Wyrmscraig . It is run by Mr Supplies Jnr , who claims this location is the headquarters of a "global chain of world class equipment providing outposts." Supplies also claims to maintain a diverse portfolio of business interests, most notably the

shops.title: Sword shops
shops.notes: Sword shops are a type of store throughout Gielinor . The stores are represented by a icon. Sword shops sell daggers , shortswords , longswords , two-handed swords , and warhammers . There are 16 dedicated sword shops in Old School RuneScape .

shops.title: Tal Teklan General Store
shops.notes: Tal Teklan General Store is located in Tal Teklan . The store is run by its shopkeeper and sells the usual assortment of items found in general stores across Gielinor. This store has no map icon, but can be found in the east of the town, just south of the bank .

shops.title: Tal Teklan Rune Shop
shops.notes: Tal Teklan Rune Shop is a shop in Tal Teklan that sells runes , run by Teicuh . It is popular for low-level Ironmen , particularly Hardcore Ironmen , as it sells nature and cosmic runes without needing extensive questing or visiting the Wilderness .

shops.title: Tamayu's Spear Stall
shops.notes: Tamayu's Spear Stall is a spear shop in Tai Bwo Wannai , owned by Tamayu , one of Timfraku 's sons. It sells karambwan -poisoned spears and cleaning cloths . It requires completion of Tai Bwo Wannai Trio to access, because during the quest Tamayu learns how to use poisoned spears. It can only be acc

shops.title: Taxidermist
shops.notes: The taxidermist in Canifis can skin and stuff special creatures for players, giving them possibility of mounting them in their Skill Hall in their house . These special items are things like big fish that can be caught rarely while Fishing or the heads of Slayer monsters randomly dropped while fight

shops.title: Temple Supplies
shops.notes: Temple Supplies is the rewards shop for the Guardians of the Rift minigame, accessed by talking to Apprentice Felix at the minigame's entrance. At the rewards shop, players can use the abyssal pearls earned in the minigame to purchase helpful items for training Runecraft .

shops.title: The Asp & Snake Bar.
shops.notes: The Asp & Snake Bar is located on the south side of Pollnivneach . As a result of it being in the town square and right on the river, it is a popular hangout amongst the locals. Ali the Barman serves players drinks from their large selection.

shops.title: The Big Heist Lodge
shops.location: Bandit Village in the Kharidian Desert
shops.notes: The Big Heist Lodge is a bar located in the Kharidian Desert Bandit Camp . It contains about 10 bandits who will all attack at once if any one of them are attacked or if the player has any Zamorak or Saradomin items equipped. This is a Multi-combat area , so caution should be used when fighting. The

shops.title: The Burrow
shops.notes: The Burrow is an underground cavern accessed from the centre of the Hunter Guild , and is primarily visited to receive Hunters' Rumours from the guild's hunters. A Hunter level of 46 is required to enter.

shops.title: The Cloak and Stagger
shops.notes: The Cloak and Stagger is a bar and an inn found in Shayzien . The only drinking establishment in Shayzien, it is run by Oswald and Sheryl and is the only location that sells the Lizardkicker .

shops.title: The Crypt
shops.notes: The Crypt is the bar located in the north-west corner of Darkmeyer . It is run by the vampyre Despoina Callidra , who sells blood pints , a beverage made of alcohol-infused blood, at the price of 2 coins. It is the only bar where blood pints can be acquired.

shops.title: The Deeper Lode
shops.notes: The Deeper Lode is a tavern owned by Fuggy , located in Lovakengj . The shop sells various alcoholic beverages.

shops.title: The Esoterican Arms
shops.notes: The Esoterican Arms is a bar located beneath Miscellania in the Miscellania Expansion in the Miscellania and Etceteria dungeon . shops.title: The Flaming Arrow
shops.notes: The Flaming Arrow is a bar found in Civitas illa Fortis .

shops.title: The Golden Field
shops.notes: The Golden Field is a tavern owned by Richard and Golova , located in Hosidius . There are many farmers swapping stories inside.

shops.title: The Green Ghost
shops.notes: The Green Ghost is an inn found in Port Phasmatys , a large seaport found in north-eastern Morytania .

shops.title: The Haymaker's Arms
shops.notes: The Haymaker's Arms was a tavern owned by Golova , located in Hosidius . The shop sold the same alcoholic beverages as The Golden Field .

shops.title: The King's Inn
shops.notes: The King's Inn is a pub located in Tal Teklan . King sells food and a wide range of alcohol.

shops.title: The Legless Faun
shops.notes: The Legless Faun is a small bar right off the docks in Great Kourend that sells beer . According to the bartender Bast , it's where all newcomers to Great Kourend find themselves after the long journey from the east.

shops.title: The Lighthouse Store
shops.notes: The Lighthouse Store is a general store located on the 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] of the Lighthouse , owned by Jossik . In addition to acting as a general store, it also sells alcoholic beverages and oddly, poison . Completion of Horror from the Deep is required in order to access the shop.

shops.title: The Long Hall
shops.notes: The Long Hall is a tavern located in the northern part of Barbarian Village . Many Barbarians are found inside. It may be dangerous to attack more than one Barbarian , especially since one or two use Ranged weapons. It has a cooked meat spawn. There are also two non-stop fires at the end of the hall

shops.title: The Lost Pickaxe
shops.notes: The Lost Pickaxe is a bar found on the north west part of Cam Torum . The bar sells steamforge brews and sun-shine not found in bars on the mainland.

shops.title: The Nutcracker
shops.notes: The Nutcracker is a pub located in the Land of Snow . Owned by Santa Claus , the prized pub is one of the most exclusive, with only winners of the Festive Games (and a plus one of the winner's choosing) being allowed to enter. The pub grounds are host to the Festive Games, which players could replay

shops.title: The Old Nite
shops.notes: The Old Nite is the pub in Ferox Enclave in the Wilderness . The bar is rather rough, with the floor strewn with broken glass and a skeleton hanging from the wall. shops.title: The Other Inn.
shops.notes: The Other Inn is in the pirate town of Mos Le'Harmless . It is run by Mama , who will sell a variety of alcoholic drinks. She can also sell Braindeath 'rum' , although only after Cabin Fever has been completed.

shops.title: The Pandemonium (pub)
shops.notes: The Pandemonium is a pub made up of ships on the southern end of the Pandemonium and is run by 'Squawking' Steve Beanie . The Pandemonium's one rule is to never disrespect one's fellow patrons, meaning customs officers and pirates can drink side-by-side even if they would otherwise be enemies.

shops.title: The Rolling Tide
shops.notes: The Rolling Tide is a pub run by the bartender at Port Roberts .

shops.title: The Runic Emporium
shops.notes: The Runic Emporium is a magic shop run by Nahta , found around the centre of Cam Torum , just north-west of the market.

shops.title: The Sheared Ram
shops.notes: The Sheared Ram is a small bar in Lumbridge that sells beer . Here, players can speak to Veos , an experienced adventurer from Great Kourend , a kingdom far west of the mainland, to start the X Marks the Spot quest.

shops.title: The Shrimp and Parrot
shops.notes: The Shrimp and Parrot is a restaurant in Brimhaven . It is run by Alfonse the waiter . During the Heroes' Quest , it is revealed that the restaurant is actually a hideout for the Phoenix Gang , set up as part of a scheme to steal Scarface Pete 's candlesticks .

shops.title: The Spice Is Right.
shops.notes: The Spice Is Right is a shop in the south-west corner of Sophanem . The shop owner is Embalmer who wanders inside the building behind his spice stall. The shop sells three dose antipoisons which can be useful for the nearby minigame Pyramid Plunder . The spice stall can be searched, but the player w

shops.title: The Toad and Chicken
shops.notes: The Toad and Chicken is a bar and an inn found in Burthorpe , north of Taverley . It caters primarily to the soldiers and citizens of Burthorpe. Wizard's mind bomb , Dwarven stout and Asgarnian ale are all purchasable from Tostig for two coins each. Players can also find a trapdoor leading to the Ro

shops.title: The Windbreaker
shops.notes: The Windbreaker is a bar in Quetzacalli Gorge . Alongside Atlazora's Rest , it is the only bar to sell moon-lite .

shops.title: Theatre of Blood Supplies
shops.notes: The Theatre of Blood Supplies is a shop accessible from a chest within the Theatre of Blood raid . It is accessible twice per raid — once after killing the Pestilent Bloat , and once after killing Sotetseg . It supplies players with different supplies provided by entertained vampyres, purchasable wi

shops.title: Thessalia's Fine Clothes.
shops.notes: Thessalia's Fine Clothes is located in central Varrock square. In addition to selling clothes, Thessalia will offer to give a player a " total clothing-makeover ". This allows the player to change the default shirt or trousers they chose when creating their character. Browsing the store is a require

shops.title: Thessalia's Makeovers
shops.notes: Thessalia's Makeovers was a shop in Varrock that could change a player 's default clothing free of charge. The makeover was run by Thessalia , who also owns another clothing shop in the same building. Players could not customise shoes here — they must have instead gone to Yrsa's Shoe Store . There w

shops.title: Thirus Urkar's Fine Dynamite Store
shops.notes: Thirus Urkar's Fine Dynamite Store is a mining shop run by Thirus located in Lovakengj , outside the blast mine .

shops.title: Thurid's Brain Buckets
shops.notes: Thurid's Brain Buckets is a shop run by Thurid located in the Sunset Coast . The shop offers medium and full helmets ranging from bronze to adamant , with the exception of black helms.

shops.title: Thyria's Wares
shops.notes: Thyria's Wares is a magic shop run by Thyria located in the house north of Regath's Wares in Arceuus .

shops.title: Tiadeche's Karambwan Stall
shops.notes: Tiadeche's Karambwan Stall is a store in Tai Bwo Wannai owned by Tiadeche . It sells raw karambwan and karambwan vessels, and can only be accessed after completion of Tai Bwo Wannai Trio , in which Tiadeche is shown how to fish.

shops.title: Tizoro's Pickaxes
shops.notes: Tizoro's Pickaxes is a shop that sells pickaxes in Cam Torum , run by Tizoro .

shops.title: Toci's Gem Store
shops.notes: Toci's Gem Store is a gem shop in Aldarin run by Toci . It has the highest amount in stock of sapphires , emeralds , and rubies of any shop outside of Mor Ul Rek , making it a good place for Ironman Mode players to obtain gems.

shops.title: Tony's Pizza Bases
shops.notes: Tony's Pizza Bases is a shop owned by Fat Tony that sells pizza bases for 4 coins each stocking them 30 at a time. The shop is located in the Wilderness Bandit Camp . Players should be careful as the shop is in the Wilderness and they risk getting attacked by PKers and Bandits .

shops.title: Toothy's Pickaxes
shops.notes: Toothy's Pickaxes is a store located in Lovakengj , near the sulphur mine , and is owned by Toothy . The shop sells pickaxes and empty pots .

shops.title: Trader Stan's Trading Post
shops.notes: Trader Stan's Trading Post is a unique series of shops, operated by the Trader crewmembers and Trader Stan . There is a separate shop instance at each of the charter ship locations.

shops.title: Trader Sven's Black-market Goods.
shops.notes: Trader Sven's Black-market Goods is a store located in Meiyerditch , owned by Trader Sven . It sells vyrewatch clothing and citizen clothing , both of which protect players from being blood tithed by Vyrewatch . Darkness of Hallowvale must be started to access Meiyerditch and his store. It is the on

shops.title: Tutab's Magical Market
shops.notes: Tutab's Magical Market is a magic shop located on Ape Atoll . Players who haven't completed Monkey Madness II who wish to access Tutab 's stall must be in monkey form; this can be achieved by holding a monkey greegree .

shops.title: Two Feet Charley's Fish Shop.
shops.notes: Two Feet Charley's Fish Shop is a fishing shop in Mos Le'Harmless owned by Charley . It sells raw fish.

shops.title: Tynan's Fishing Supplies
shops.notes: Tynan's Fishing Supplies is located in Port Piscarilius , directly east of the bank. The shop sells empty buckets , small and big fishing nets , fishing rods , harpoons , lobster pots , bait , and sandworms (which are used to catch anglerfish ). It is run by Tynan .

shops.title: TzHaar-Hur-Lek's Ore and Gem Store
shops.notes: TzHaar-Hur-Lek's Ore and Gem Store is located in the outer city of Mor Ul Rek , west of TzHaar-Hur-Tel's Equipment Store and north of TzHaar-Mej-Roh's Rune Store .

shops.title: TzHaar-Hur-Rin's Ore and Gem Store
shops.notes: TzHaar-Hur-Rin's Ore and Gem Store is located in the south-east section of the inner city of Mor Ul Rek , east of TzHaar-Hur-Zal's Equipment Store . A fire cape is required to access the store.

shops.title: TzHaar-Hur-Tel's Equipment Store
shops.notes: TzHaar-Hur-Tel's Equipment Store is located in Mor Ul Rek . It is located east of TzHaar-Hur-Lek's Ore and Gem Store . The store is run by TzHaar-Hur-Tel . The store sells obsidian weapons and equipment for varying amounts of Tokkul .

shops.title: TzHaar-Hur-Zal's Equipment Store
shops.notes: The TzHaar-Hur-Zal's Equipment Store is located in Mor Ul Rek . It is located just south of the entrance to Inferno . The store is run by TzHaar-Hur-Zal . The store sells obsidian equipment and Obsidian armour for varying amounts of Tokkul . A fire cape is required to access the inner part of the ci

shops.title: TzHaar-Mej-Roh's Rune Store
shops.notes: The TzHaar-Mej-Roh's Rune Store is a magic shop located in the outer ring of Mor Ul Rek . It is located south of TzHaar-Hur-Lek's Ore and Gem Store . The store is run by TzHaar-Mej-Roh . The store sells runes for varying amounts of Tokkul .

shops.title: Unused shops
shops.notes: Unused shops are Shops that, although existing in the game config, cannot be found anywhere ingame. These shops are primarily unused duplicates of existing shops, but some were previously accessible before being removed, while others were never released ingame.

shops.title: Useful Supplies
shops.notes: Useful Supplies is a shop accessible from a chest during The Blood Moon Rises quest . It offers free supplies to aid the player in battle against Lowerniel Drakan .

shops.title: Valaine's Shop of Champions.
shops.location: 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] of Champions' Guild
shops.notes: Valaine's Shop of Champions is a shop located on the 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] of the Champions' Guild . It is operated by Valaine .

shops.title: Vale Research Exchange
shops.notes: The Vale Research Exchange is the rewards shop for the Vale Totems minigame , accessed by talking to Ranulph in Auburnvale . The shop stocks several unique items which are helpful for training Fletching .

shops.title: Vanessa's Farming shop.
shops.notes: Vanessa's Farming shop is a Farming shop in Catherby selling various Farming items run by Vanessa . There is a Farming shop near all the allotments , which is useful if players forget to bring an item.

shops.title: Vannah's Farming Stall
shops.notes: Vannah's Farming Stall is a farming shop located in Hosidius in the farmer's market. It is run by Vannah and it sells farming supplies.

shops.title: Varrock General Store
shops.notes: The Varrock General Store is one of the most popular stores in the game. Located in the centre of Varrock , it is a general store that is fairly typical of other such similar stores found in the game.

shops.title: Varrock Swordshop
shops.notes: The Varrock Swordshop is a shop in southern Varrock run by a Shop keeper . The shop can be found opposite the Blue Moon Inn . shops.title: Vegetable shops
shops.notes: Vegetable stores are a type of store. They are marked by a icon.

shops.title: Vermundi's Clothes Stall
shops.notes: Vermundi's Clothes Stall is a clothes stall found on the eastern side of Keldagrim Palace . It stocks a variety of brown dwarven clothing; the pink and blue varieties can be found on the western side of the palace, at Agmundi Quality Clothes . Despite being sold in Keldagrim, players may still wear

shops.title: Vigr's Warhammers
shops.notes: Vigr's Warhammers is a shop that sells warhammers , and is owned by Vigr . It is located in Keldagrim , in the west side of Keldagrim Palace , on the ground floor [ UK ] 1 st floor [ US ] , and is labelled on the map as a sword shop.

shops.title: Void Knight Archery Store
shops.notes: The Void Knight Archery Store is an archery shop found at the Void Knights' Outpost . It is run by a Squire and sells javelins and arrowheads up to rune .

shops.title: Void Knight General Store
shops.notes: Void Knight General Store is a general store operated by a Void Knight Squire . It is located on the western side of the Void Knights' Outpost .

shops.title: Void Knight Magic Store
shops.notes: The Void Knight Magic Store is located on the Void Knights' Outpost . The store is run by a Squire and supplies fire , air , water , earth , mind , chaos , and death runes .

shops.title: Void Knights' Reward Options
shops.notes: The Void Knights' Reward Options is the rewards shop for the Pest Control minigame, accessed by talking to any Void Knight . At the rewards shop, players can use commendation points earned by completing rounds of Pest Control to purchase experience, Void Knight equipment , and various resource packs

shops.title: Warrens Fish Monger
shops.notes: Warrens Fish Monger is a Fish stall located in The Warrens . The shop sells Fishing supplies. It is run by the Fish monger .

shops.title: Warrens General Store
shops.notes: The Warrens General Store is a general store run by a Shop keeper in The Warrens . A manhole in the centre of Port Piscarilius , just west of Captain Khaled , must be climbed down to enter The Warrens.

shops.title: Warrior Guild Armoury
shops.location: 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] of Warriors' Guild
shops.notes: The Warrior Guild Armoury is an armour and weapons shop found in the Burthorpe Warriors' Guild . It is run by Anton .

shops.title: Warrior Guild Food Shop
shops.location: Ground floor [ UK ] 1 st floor [ US ] of Warriors' Guild
shops.notes: The Warrior Guild Food Shop is a store found in the Burthorpe Warriors' Guild . It is overseen by Lidio , and sells a variety of food items capable of healing players' hitpoints .

shops.title: Warrior Guild Potion Shop
shops.location: ground floor [ UK ] 1 st floor [ US ] of the Warriors' Guild
shops.notes: The Warrior Guild Potion Shop is a store found in the Burthorpe Warriors' Guild . It is overseen by Lilly , and sells a variety of lower-level combat -related potions .

shops.title: Wayne's Chains! - Chainmail specialist.
shops.notes: Wayne's Chains is a shop owned by Wayne located in southern Falador . It is the only shop that specialises exclusively in chainbodies .

shops.title: Weapons galore
shops.notes: Weapons galore is a weapons store located in south-west Jatizso . The store specialises in weapons , specifically mithril , of which 4 of each weapon is stocked. The shop purchases these weapons for more than their high alch value. One of the towns major resources is mining and smithing, which allow

shops.title: West Ardougne General Store
shops.notes: The West Ardougne General Store is run by Chadwell in West Ardougne . It is where most of the city's populace get their food from.

shops.title: Where Wyrmscraig's Wear Wares Were
shops.notes: Where Wyrmscraig's Wear Wares Were is a clothing store run by Declan , located in Auchrie on the island of Wyrmscraig . It can only be accessed after completion of Fallen From Grace .

shops.title: White Knight Armoury
shops.notes: The White Knight Armoury is run by Sir Vyvin , located on the 2 nd floor [ UK ] 3 rd floor [ US ] of the White Knights' Castle on the east side. It requires completion of the Wanted! quest to access, and the white equipment stocked depends on the number of black knights the player has killed. Additi

shops.title: William's Wilderness Cape Shop.
shops.notes: William's Wilderness Cape Shop is a shop located near the Red Dragon Isle and owned by William . It sells the 1 variety of team capes. This seller is actually closer to demonic ruins on the west side.

shops.title: Wine Shop.
shops.notes: Wine Shop is a wine trader run by Fortunato next to his Market stall (wine) located in Draynor Village 's marketplace. Fortunato stocks bottles and jugs of wine , as well as jugs of vinegar , which are used in the Rag and Bone Man I quest.

shops.title: Wine traders
shops.notes: Wine traders are a type of store found in Old School RuneScape . On the world map they are identified by the wine trader icon . These stores primarily sell various types of wine.

shops.title: Worm Tongue's Wares
shops.notes: Worm Tongue's Wares is a shop that sells rewards for the Colossal Wyrm Agility Course . Items can only be purchased using Termites . It is run by Worm Tongue , who can be found in the centre of the agility course.

shops.title: Yarnio's Baked Goods
shops.notes: Yarnio's Baked Goods is a food shop at the centre of Cam Torum . It is run by Yarnio .

shops.title: Yarsul's Prodigious Pickaxes
shops.notes: Yarsul's Prodigious Pickaxes is a store that sells pickaxes inside the Mining Guild 's outer area, requiring 60 Mining to access. The shop is run by Yarsul .

shops.title: Ye olde Tea Shoppe.
shops.notes: Ye olde Tea Shoppe is a Tea stall located in south-eastern Varrock , next to the city wall. The shop is owned by the tea seller . The player can either buy tea from the shop or steal it with a Thieving level of 5, granting 16 experience . It takes roughly four seconds for the stall to reset and one

shops.title: Yrsa's Accoutrements
shops.notes: Yrsa's Accoutrements is a shop run by Yrsa in Rellekka , west of the marketplace. The shop stocks clothing such as Fremennik cloaks , Fremennik shirts , Fremennik hats , Fremennik robes , Fremennik skirts , and Fremennik gloves . Yrsa can also change the appearance of players' boots for a small fee.

shops.title: Yrsa's Shoe Store
shops.notes: Yrsa's Shoe Store was a shop in Rellekka . As well as selling clothes , Yrsa could change your shoe colour and style free of charge. Both access to the store's stock and the ability to change one's shoes required the completion of The Fremennik Trials quest . Visiting the store was a part of the eas

shops.title: Zaff's Superior Staffs!
shops.notes: Zaff's Superior Staffs is a staff shop located near central Varrock , owned by Zaff . It is the main source of battlestaves and of elemental staves for free players .

shops.title: Zanaris General Store
shops.notes: The Zanaris General Store is run by the fairy shop keeper and her assistant , both denizens of Zanaris .

shops.title: Zeke's Superior Scimitars.
shops.notes: Zeke's Superior Scimitars is located in Al Kharid , just north-east of the bank . It is run by Zeke , and sells scimitars up to mithril .

shops.title: Zenesha's Plate Mail Body Shop.
shops.notes: Zenesha's Plate Mail Body Shop is a shop owned by Zenesha in East Ardougne . As the name suggests, it sells types of platebodies . These platebodies range from bronze to mithril.

shops.title: ~ Uglug's stuffsies ~
shops.notes: Uglug's stuffsies is a store run by Uglug Nar in Jiggig . He offers various items, including brutal arrows and Relicym's balm . He also buys Sanfew serums , raw chompies , and ogre coffin keys . To unlock his store, players are required to sell him a Relicym's balm after starting Zogre Flesh Eaters
